records.key: 'bundled' is the historical packaged plaque model. It is kept so an old run can be reproduced; it misses about a third of the plaques on literature images. toxoplasma_plaque_v2 is the current model.
records.source: 'bundled' is the historical packaged plaque model. It is kept so an old run can be reproduced; it misses about a third of the plaques on literature images. toxoplasma_plaque_v2 is the current model.
records.translation: 'bundled' er sögulega pakkaða skellulíkanið. Því er haldið svo hægt sé að endurgera gamla keyrslu; það missir af um þriðjungi skellnanna á myndum úr greinum. toxoplasma_plaque_v2 er núverandi líkan.

records.key: (bool) drop_straight_tracks — remove the flagged tracks entirely.
records.source: (bool) drop_straight_tracks — remove the flagged tracks entirely.
records.translation: (bool) drop_straight_tracks — fjarlægja merktu ferlana alveg.

records.key:
Report errors as GitHub issues
Reports go to the public spaCR repository on GitHub, with paths, names and credentials redacted. With issue reporting set to always, the default, a failed run files its report automatically, once per error, when GitHub is signed in below. With ask, a "File as issue" button appears under the console and the report is sent only when you press Send report in its preview. Change it under Help → Set spaCR up again….

records.translation:
Tilkynna villur sem mál á GitHub
Skýrslur fara í opinberu spaCR-kóðageymsluna á GitHub, með slóðir, nöfn og aðgangsupplýsingar fjarlægð. Þegar villutilkynningar eru stilltar á always, sem er sjálfgefið, skráir keyrsla sem mistekst skýrslu sína sjálfkrafa, einu sinni fyrir hverja villu, þegar innskráð er á GitHub hér fyrir neðan. Með ask birtist hnappurinn "File as issue" undir stjórnborðinu og skýrslan er aðeins send þegar þú ýtir á Senda skýrslu í forskoðun hennar. Breyttu þessu undir Hjálp → Setja spaCR upp aftur….

records.key: A .pt or .pth file holding a model that takes one channel and returns one channel of logits. HEAVY: the file is loaded and the network is run, which on a CPU is seconds per box and minutes per field.
records.source: A .pt or .pth file holding a model that takes one channel and returns one channel of logits. HEAVY: the file is loaded and the network is run, which on a CPU is seconds per box and minutes per field.
records.translation: .pt- eða .pth-skrá með líkani sem tekur eina rás og skilar einni rás af logits. ÞUNGT: skráin er hlaðin og netið keyrt, sem á CPU tekur sekúndur á hvern kassa og mínútur á hvert sjónsvið.

records.key: A 4PL is symmetric about its midpoint. Real asymmetry exists, and a 4PL absorbs it into a displaced EC50; the 5PL fits it with one more parameter, needs one more concentration, and says whether that parameter earned itself.
records.source: A 4PL is symmetric about its midpoint. Real asymmetry exists, and a 4PL absorbs it into a displaced EC50; the 5PL fits it with one more parameter, needs one more concentration, and says whether that parameter earned itself.
records.translation: 4PL er samhverft um miðpunkt sinn. Raunveruleg ósamhverfa er til, og 4PL tekur hana upp í tilfært EC50; 5PL mátar hana með einum stika í viðbót, þarf einum styrk fleiri og segir til um hvort sá stiki hafi átt rétt á sér.

records.key: A DOI, PMID or PMC id is fetched from Europe PMC with its figure legends; a PDF is read page by page. The figures go into a new folder, with their legends in legends.csv, and the preview switches to it.
records.source: A DOI, PMID or PMC id is fetched from Europe PMC with its figure legends; a PDF is read page by page. The figures go into a new folder, with their legends in legends.csv, and the preview switches to it.
records.translation: DOI, PMID eða PMC-auðkenni er sótt frá Europe PMC ásamt myndatextum; PDF er lesin síðu fyrir síðu. Myndirnar fara í nýja möppu, með myndatextana í legends.csv, og forskoðunin skiptir yfir í hana.

records.key: A WAV file of your own for the music bed to play instead of spaCR's. Leave it empty for spaCR's own music. Nothing is uploaded or copied: the file is read from where it is, and it is also what the Resonance background moves to.
records.source: A WAV file of your own for the music bed to play instead of spaCR's. Leave it empty for spaCR's own music. Nothing is uploaded or copied: the file is read from where it is, and it is also what the Resonance background moves to.
records.translation: Þín eigin WAV-skrá sem bakgrunnstónlistin spilar í stað tónlistar spaCR. Hafðu autt fyrir eigin tónlist spaCR. Engu er hlaðið upp eða afritað: skráin er lesin þaðan sem hún er, og það er líka hún sem Resonance-bakgrunnurinn hreyfist eftir.

records.key: A chosen annotation column in measurements/measurements.db, table png_list; labels belong to object identities.
records.source: A chosen annotation column in measurements/measurements.db, table png_list; labels belong to object identities.
records.translation: Valinn merkingadálkur í measurements/measurements.db, taflan png_list; merki tilheyra auðkennum hluta.

records.key: A condition over the crop table's own columns, in SQL. The database is opened read-only, so nothing typed here can change it.
records.source: A condition over the crop table's own columns, in SQL. The database is opened read-only, so nothing typed here can change it.
records.translation: Skilyrði á eigin dálka myndskurðatöflunnar, í SQL. Gagnagrunnurinn er opnaður með lesaðgangi eingöngu, svo ekkert sem slegið er inn hér getur breytt honum.

records.key: A generic budding-yeast cell from SwissBioPics. Hover for a UniProt location description and check several compartments to keep them highlighted. This is a cell schematic, not a Candida species identification or a depiction of every yeast, pseudohyphal and hyphal form.
records.source: A generic budding-yeast cell from SwissBioPics. Hover for a UniProt location description and check several compartments to keep them highlighted. This is a cell schematic, not a Candida species identification or a depiction of every yeast, pseudohyphal and hyphal form.
records.translation: Almenn knappskotsgerfruma frá SwissBioPics. Haltu bendlinum yfir til að sjá lýsingu á staðsetningu frá UniProt og hakaðu við nokkur hólf til að halda þeim auðkenndum. Þetta er skýringarmynd af frumu, ekki greining á Candida-tegund né lýsing á öllum gers-, gervisveppþráða- og sveppþráðaformum.

records.key: A growing bud is an asexual reproductive structure, as in yeast or a hydra, that consists of an outgrowth capable of developing into a new individual.
records.source: A growing bud is an asexual reproductive structure, as in yeast or a hydra, that consists of an outgrowth capable of developing into a new individual.
records.translation: Vaxandi knappur er kynlaus æxlunarbygging, eins og hjá geri eða holsepa, sem samanstendur af útvexti sem getur þroskast í nýjan einstakling.

records.key: A measurements database lets you choose which objects to embed. A crop folder takes every PNG in it.
records.source: A measurements database lets you choose which objects to embed. A crop folder takes every PNG in it.
records.translation: Mælingagagnagrunnur leyfir þér að velja hvaða hluti á að fella inn. Myndskurðamappa tekur hverja PNG í henni.

records.key: A model is already downloading; wait for it to finish.
records.source: A model is already downloading; wait for it to finish.
records.translation: Líkan er þegar í niðurhali; bíddu þar til því lýkur.

records.key: A quiet looping piece in the sound set's key: pads, a plucked arpeggio with a dotted-eighth echo, a soft sub, and a quiet four-on-the-floor kick and shaker that come and go with the arrangement. Separate from the other sounds, so you can have feedback without music. It rests at the Laptop and Extra Performance levels.
records.source: A quiet looping piece in the sound set's key: pads, a plucked arpeggio with a dotted-eighth echo, a soft sub, and a quiet four-on-the-floor kick and shaker that come and go with the arrangement. Separate from the other sounds, so you can have feedback without music. It rests at the Laptop and Extra Performance levels.
records.translation: Hljóðlátt lykkjuverk í tóntegund hljóðasettsins: hljóðmottur, plokkað arpeggio með bergmáli á punkteraðri áttundapartsnótu, mjúkur djúpbassi og hljóðlátur jafn bassatrommutaktur og hristur sem koma og fara með útsetningunni. Aðskilið frá hinum hljóðunum, svo þú getur haft endurgjöf án tónlistar. Það þagnar á stigunum Fartölva og Extra Performance.

records.key: A rising arpeggio that resolves onto the key's home note when a module's run finishes successfully, for when spaCR is in another window.
records.source: A rising arpeggio that resolves onto the key's home note when a module's run finishes successfully, for when spaCR is in another window.
records.translation: Rísandi arpeggio sem leysist upp á grunntón tóntegundarinnar þegar keyrslu einingar lýkur með árangri, fyrir þegar spaCR er í öðrum glugga.

records.key: A shared apicomplexan cell plan, using the SwissBioPics artwork also used in Starplast. Hover for a UniProt location description and check several compartments to keep them highlighted. Parasite shape and organelle organization vary by species and life-cycle stage; this is not a blood-stage reconstruction. Toxoplasma hyperLOPIT assignments are not transferred to Plasmodium.
records.source: A shared apicomplexan cell plan, using the SwissBioPics artwork also used in Starplast. Hover for a UniProt location description and check several compartments to keep them highlighted. Parasite shape and organelle organization vary by species and life-cycle stage; this is not a blood-stage reconstruction. Toxoplasma hyperLOPIT assignments are not transferred to Plasmodium.
records.translation: Sameiginleg frumuteikning fyrir Apicomplexa, með SwissBioPics-myndefninu sem einnig er notað í Starplast. Haltu bendlinum yfir til að sjá lýsingu á staðsetningu frá UniProt og hakaðu við nokkur hólf til að halda þeim auðkenndum. Lögun sníkjudýrsins og skipulag frumulíffæra eru breytileg eftir tegund og stigi lífsferils; þetta er ekki endurgerð blóðstigs. Úthlutanir hyperLOPIT fyrir Toxoplasma eru ekki yfirfærðar á Plasmodium.

records.key: A short, quiet pluck in the sound set's key when you press a button, a switch, a tab, a list or a slider: confirmation that the press registered, felt more than heard.
records.source: A short, quiet pluck in the sound set's key when you press a button, a switch, a tab, a list or a slider: confirmation that the press registered, felt more than heard.
records.translation: Stuttur, hljóðlátur plokkaður tónn í tóntegund hljóðasettsins þegar þú ýtir á hnapp, rofa, flipa, lista eða sleða: staðfesting á að ýtt var, meira fundin en heyrð.

records.key: A slower falling figure when a run stops with an error, so a finished run and a failed one never sound alike. A run you stop yourself is silent.
records.source: A slower falling figure when a run stops with an error, so a finished run and a failed one never sound alike. A run you stop yourself is silent.
records.translation: Hægari fallandi tónaröð þegar keyrsla stöðvast með villu, svo lokin keyrsla og misheppnuð hljóma aldrei eins. Keyrsla sem þú stöðvar sjálf/ur er hljóðlaus.

records.key: A suggestion run is going; judge its suggestions when it has finished.
records.source: A suggestion run is going; judge its suggestions when it has finished.
records.translation: Tillögukeyrsla er í gangi; mettu tillögur hennar þegar henni er lokið.

records.key: A template is this module's settings under a name you chose. Save one when a plate is set up the way you want it; apply it next time instead of retyping.
records.source: A template is this module's settings under a name you chose. Save one when a plate is set up the way you want it; apply it next time instead of retyping.
records.translation: Sniðmát er stillingar þessarar einingar undir heiti sem þú valdir. Vistaðu eitt þegar plata er uppsett eins og þú vilt; beittu því næst í stað þess að slá allt inn aftur.

records.key: Acquire and measure the experiment first, preserving dose/condition identities.
records.source: Acquire and measure the experiment first, preserving dose/condition identities.
records.translation: Taktu fyrst myndir og mældu tilraunina, og varðveittu auðkenni skammta/aðstæðna.

records.key: Add back a high-pass copy of the image, which makes edges steeper and helps a threshold land on the boundary rather than in the halo. Too much amount puts a bright rim around every object and a dark moat outside it.
records.source: Add back a high-pass copy of the image, which makes edges steeper and helps a threshold land on the boundary rather than in the halo. Too much amount puts a bright rim around every object and a dark moat outside it.
records.translation: Bæta aftur við hápassaafriti af myndinni, sem gerir brúnir brattari og hjálpar þröskuldi að lenda á mörkunum frekar en í geislabaugnum. Of mikið magn setur bjarta brún utan um hvern hlut og dökkt síki fyrir utan.

records.key:
Adds spaCR's DEBUG messages to the log files in ~/.spacr/logs. It also lets cellpose report which model it loaded, and it records which buttons you pressed. That trail is what makes a bug report worth reading.

Starting spaCR and opening its screens took no longer with this on. This was measured on one workstation by opening every module, once with this on and once with it off. Home was ready in about 4 seconds after a cold start both ways. The slowest module opened in about 7 seconds both ways. Pipeline runs were not timed.

The Console still shows only the levels you switch on for it on the Logging tab. This switch does not trace every function call. That tracer is a separate tool for developers, and nothing here turns it on.
records.source:
Adds spaCR's DEBUG messages to the log files in ~/.spacr/logs. It also lets cellpose report which model it loaded, and it records which buttons you pressed. That trail is what makes a bug report worth reading.

Starting spaCR and opening its screens took no longer with this on. This was measured on one workstation by opening every module, once with this on and once with it off. Home was ready in about 4 seconds after a cold start both ways. The slowest module opened in about 7 seconds both ways. Pipeline runs were not timed.

The Console still shows only the levels you switch on for it on the Logging tab. This switch does not trace every function call. That tracer is a separate tool for developers, and nothing here turns it on.
records.translation:
Bætir DEBUG-skilaboðum spaCR við annálaskrárnar í ~/.spacr/logs. Það leyfir einnig cellpose að greina frá hvaða líkani það hlóð, og það skráir hvaða hnappa þú ýttir á. Sú slóð er það sem gerir villuskýrslu þess virði að lesa hana.

Ræsing spaCR og opnun skjáa þess tók ekki lengri tíma með þetta virkt. Þetta var mælt á einni vinnustöð með því að opna allar einingar, einu sinni með þetta virkt og einu sinni óvirkt. Heimaskjárinn var tilbúinn á um 4 sekúndum eftir kalda ræsingu í báðum tilvikum. Hægasta einingin opnaðist á um 7 sekúndum í báðum tilvikum. Keyrslur vinnsluferla voru ekki tímamældar.

Stjórnborðið sýnir áfram aðeins þau stig sem þú kveikir á fyrir það í flipanum Annálar. Þessi rofi rekur ekki hvert fallakall. Sá rakari er sérstakt tól fyrir forritara og ekkert hér kveikir á honum.

records.key: Aggregate the selected measurement by well and inspect plate patterns and controls.
records.source: Aggregate the selected measurement by well and inspect plate patterns and controls.
records.translation: Taktu valda mælingu saman eftir brunni og skoðaðu mynstur og viðmið á plötunni.

records.key: Align & Stitch destination: composed image and the tile-coordinate/layout records needed to interpret it.
records.source: Align & Stitch destination: composed image and the tile-coordinate/layout records needed to interpret it.
records.translation: Áfangastaður Align & Stitch: samsett mynd og færslur um hnit/uppsetningu reita sem þarf til að túlka hana.

records.key: All eight Plasmodium modules on this page are planned. Their descriptions define intended readouts rather than available analysis pipelines. PlasmoDB and UniProt provide genome and protein context for choosing markers and interpreting results. The apicomplexan illustration is useful for discussing compartments shared with Toxoplasma, but it does not establish that a protein has the same location in both organisms.
records.source: All eight Plasmodium modules on this page are planned. Their descriptions define intended readouts rather than available analysis pipelines. PlasmoDB and UniProt provide genome and protein context for choosing markers and interpreting results. The apicomplexan illustration is useful for discussing compartments shared with Toxoplasma, but it does not establish that a protein has the same location in both organisms.
records.translation: Allar átta Plasmodium-einingarnar á þessari síðu eru fyrirhugaðar. Lýsingar þeirra skilgreina fyrirhugaðar mælingar frekar en tiltæk greiningarferli. PlasmoDB og UniProt veita samhengi erfðamengis og próteina við val á merkjum og túlkun niðurstaðna. Apicomplexa-myndin nýtist til að ræða hólf sem eru sameiginleg með Toxoplasma, en hún sýnir ekki fram á að prótein hafi sömu staðsetningu í báðum lífverum.

records.key: Also provide the matching crops and channel preprocessing.
records.source: Also provide the matching crops and channel preprocessing.
records.translation: Gefðu einnig upp samsvarandi myndskurði og forvinnslu rása.

records.key: An even quieter pluck when the pointer rests on an enabled control. It waits for the pointer to settle and then stays silent for a moment, so moving across a panel never turns into a stream of sounds. Off until you switch it on here.
records.source: An even quieter pluck when the pointer rests on an enabled control. It waits for the pointer to settle and then stays silent for a moment, so moving across a panel never turns into a stream of sounds. Off until you switch it on here.
records.translation: Enn hljóðlátari plokkaður tónn þegar bendillinn hvílir á virkri stýringu. Hann bíður þess að bendillinn staðnæmist og þegir svo í smástund, svo hreyfing yfir spjald verður aldrei að straumi hljóða. Óvirkt þar til þú kveikir á því hér.

records.key: An exported .h5ad file containing measured features and object metadata.
records.source: An exported .h5ad file containing measured features and object metadata.
records.translation: Útflutt .h5ad-skrá sem inniheldur mælda eiginleika og lýsigögn hluta.

records.key: Analyse plaque images or existing masks with the configured plaque model. This route need not pass through Measure; use the dedicated plaque example.
records.source: Analyse plaque images or existing masks with the configured plaque model. This route need not pass through Measure; use the dedicated plaque example.
records.translation: Greindu skellumyndir eða fyrirliggjandi grímur með stilltu skellulíkani. Þessi leið þarf ekki að fara gegnum Mælingu; notaðu sérstaka skelludæmið.

records.key: Antifungal response is a proposed concentration-response workflow for fungal growth and morphology. Combining it with Morphology or Biofilm would help describe which image features change during treatment. All eight Candida modules are currently planned and their tiles are marked Coming soon. The Candida Genome Database and UniProt provide gene and protein annotations to support marker selection and interpretation.
records.source: Antifungal response is a proposed concentration-response workflow for fungal growth and morphology. Combining it with Morphology or Biofilm would help describe which image features change during treatment. All eight Candida modules are currently planned and their tiles are marked Coming soon. The Candida Genome Database and UniProt provide gene and protein annotations to support marker selection and interpretation.
records.translation: Svörun við sveppalyfjum er fyrirhugað verkflæði fyrir styrk-svörun við vexti og formfræði sveppa. Samþætting við Morphology eða Biofilm myndi hjálpa til við að lýsa hvaða myndeiginleikar breytast við meðferð. Allar átta Candida-einingarnar eru nú fyrirhugaðar og reitir þeirra eru merktir Væntanlegt. Candida Genome Database og UniProt veita skýringar á genum og próteinum til stuðnings vali á merkjum og túlkun.

records.key: Applied to what the detector found, not to the image. Opening erases what is thinner than the radius, which breaks two objects joined by a bridge; Closing fills what is thinner, which joins one object broken into pieces.
records.source: Applied to what the detector found, not to the image. Opening erases what is thinner than the radius, which breaks two objects joined by a bridge; Closing fills what is thinner, which joins one object broken into pieces.
records.translation: Beitt á það sem skynjarinn fann, ekki á myndina. Opnun þurrkar út það sem er grennra en radíusinn, sem rýfur tvo hluti sem tengdir eru með brú; Lokun fyllir það sem er grennra, sem tengir saman hlut sem hefur brotnað í búta.

records.key: Apply compatible gates, then review candidate labels.
records.source: Apply compatible gates, then review candidate labels.
records.translation: Beittu samrýmanlegum valsvæðum og yfirfarðu svo tillögur að merkjum.

records.key: Apply the matching image classifier and preprocessing to inspect saliency/model-response maps.
records.source: Apply the matching image classifier and preprocessing to inspect saliency/model-response maps.
records.translation: Beittu samsvarandi myndflokkara og forvinnslu til að skoða áberandi-/svörunarkort líkans.

records.key: Apply the selected segmentation model to the open image folder through Make Masks; inspect saved labels before measuring them.
records.source: Apply the selected segmentation model to the open image folder through Make Masks; inspect saved labels before measuring them.
records.translation: Beittu valda hlutunarlíkaninu á opnu myndamöppuna gegnum Make Masks; skoðaðu vistuð merki áður en þau eru mæld.

records.key: Assay-specific result tables and figures in the configured destination, preserving well and condition identities.
records.source: Assay-specific result tables and figures in the configured destination, preserving well and condition identities.
records.translation: Prófsértækar niðurstöðutöflur og myndir á stilltum áfangastað, með auðkenni brunna og aðstæðna varðveitt.

records.key: Assign corresponding images and existing integer label masks, then create and measure a spaCR project without rerunning segmentation.
records.source: Assign corresponding images and existing integer label masks, then create and measure a spaCR project without rerunning segmentation.
records.translation: Tengdu samsvarandi myndir og fyrirliggjandi heiltölumerkjagrímur, búðu svo til og mældu spaCR-verkefni án þess að keyra hlutun aftur.

records.key: Attach the folder this model was trained on. It is packed into a single tar and uploaded beside the checkpoint. Large folders take a long time to pack and upload; the limit is about 25 GB.
records.source: Attach the folder this model was trained on. It is packed into a single tar and uploaded beside the checkpoint. Large folders take a long time to pack and upload; the limit is about 25 GB.
records.translation: Hengja við möppuna sem þetta líkan var þjálfað á. Hún er pökkuð í eina tar-skrá og hlaðið upp við hlið vistunarpunktsins. Stórar möppur taka langan tíma að pakka og hlaða upp; hámarkið er um 25 GB.

records.key: Browse selected tables and export rows; table inspection does not rerun image analysis.
records.source: Browse selected tables and export rows; table inspection does not rerun image analysis.
records.translation: Flettu í völdum töflum og fluttu út raðir; skoðun taflna keyrir myndgreiningu ekki aftur.

records.key: Candida yeasts can live on the skin and mucosal surfaces. Some species cause superficial or invasive candidiasis. Candida albicans can form budding yeasts, germ tubes and hyphae; these forms are not shared by every Candida species. Imaging can quantify morphology, biofilm growth and interactions with host cells.
records.source: Candida yeasts can live on the skin and mucosal surfaces. Some species cause superficial or invasive candidiasis. Candida albicans can form budding yeasts, germ tubes and hyphae; these forms are not shared by every Candida species. Imaging can quantify morphology, biofilm growth and interactions with host cells.
records.translation: Candida-ger geta lifað á húð og slímhúðum. Sumar tegundir valda yfirborðs- eða ífarandi hvítsveppasýkingu. Candida albicans getur myndað knappskotsger, kímpípur og sveppþræði; þessi form eru ekki sameiginleg öllum Candida-tegundum. Myndgreining getur magngreint formfræði, vöxt líffilmu og samskipti við hýsilfrumur.

records.key: Carry tile coordinates and original sequencing cycles into OPS; a flattened mosaic alone is insufficient.
records.source: Carry tile coordinates and original sequencing cycles into OPS; a flattened mosaic alone is insufficient.
records.translation: Fluttu hnit reita og upprunalegar raðgreiningarumferðir inn í OPS; flöt mósaíkmynd ein og sér dugar ekki.

records.key: Cellpose 3 restoration finished in {seconds} s.
records.source: Cellpose 3 restoration finished in {seconds} s.
records.translation: Cellpose 3 endurheimt lauk á {seconds} s.

records.key: Cellpose 3 restoration is running on the whole field…
records.source: Cellpose 3 restoration is running on the whole field…
records.translation: Cellpose 3 endurheimt keyrir á öllu sjónsviðinu…

records.key: Cellpose 3 with Diameter 0 first estimates the object size and rescales the whole field to it. On a 1994 x 1994 Toxoplasma field on the CPU that took 153 s and guessed 16 px for vacuoles of 44 px; with Diameter 44 it took 12 s. Set Diameter to the objects' size in pixels to skip the estimate.
records.source: Cellpose 3 with Diameter 0 first estimates the object size and rescales the whole field to it. On a 1994 x 1994 Toxoplasma field on the CPU that took 153 s and guessed 16 px for vacuoles of 44 px; with Diameter 44 it took 12 s. Set Diameter to the objects' size in pixels to skip the estimate.
records.translation: Cellpose 3 með Þvermál 0 metur fyrst stærð hlutanna og endurkvarðar allt sjónsviðið að henni. Á 1994 x 1994 Toxoplasma-sjónsviði á CPU tók það 153 s og giskaði á 16 px fyrir safabólur sem voru 44 px; með Þvermál 44 tók það 12 s. Stilltu Þvermál á stærð hlutanna í pixlum til að sleppa matinu.

records.key: Changes re-propose the conditions at once from the text already read. The second reading needs a new Run preview.
records.source: Changes re-propose the conditions at once from the text already read. The second reading needs a new Run preview.
records.translation: Breytingar leggja aðstæðurnar til aftur strax út frá textanum sem þegar var lesinn. Seinni lesturinn krefst nýrrar Keyra forskoðun.

records.key: Channel {channel}: ratio {ratio}, {state}.
records.source: Channel {channel}: ratio {ratio}, {state}.
records.translation: Rás {channel}: hlutfall {ratio}, {state}.

records.key: Check mapping and coverage before guide filtering.
records.source: Check mapping and coverage before guide filtering.
records.translation: Athugaðu vörpun og þekju áður en leiðarar eru síaðir.

records.key: Checking the installed Starplast version and PyPI…
records.source: Checking the installed Starplast version and PyPI…
records.translation: Athuga uppsetta útgáfu Starplast og PyPI…

records.key: Choose Computer Vision for crops or streamed object images, or Tabular Machine Learning for measured feature columns. The two families consume different inputs.
records.source: Choose Computer Vision for crops or streamed object images, or Tabular Machine Learning for measured feature columns. The two families consume different inputs.
records.translation: Veldu Tölvusjón fyrir myndskurði eða streymdar myndir af hlutum, eða Vélnám á töflugögnum fyrir dálka mældra eiginleika. Fjölskyldurnar tvær nota ólík inntök.

records.key: Choose a measured field. Counts and infection fractions refer only to this field.
records.source: Choose a measured field. Counts and infection fractions refer only to this field.
records.translation: Veldu mælt sjónsvið. Talningar og sýkingarhlutföll eiga aðeins við þetta sjónsvið.

records.key: Choose a measured project in the source setting first.
records.source: Choose a measured project in the source setting first.
records.translation: Veldu fyrst mælt verkefni í upprunastillingunni.

records.key: Choose a measurements database or a folder of crop PNGs above, then press Load crops. A database can be narrowed to one object class, one plate, or any condition its columns support.
records.source: Choose a measurements database or a folder of crop PNGs above, then press Load crops. A database can be narrowed to one object class, one plate, or any condition its columns support.
records.translation: Veldu mælingagagnagrunn eða möppu með myndskurðum (PNGs) hér að ofan og ýttu svo á Hlaða myndskurðum. Þrengja má gagnagrunn að einum hlutaflokki, einni plötu eða hvaða skilyrði sem dálkar hans styðja.

records.key: Choose a measurements database or a folder of crop PNGs first.
records.source: Choose a measurements database or a folder of crop PNGs first.
records.translation: Veldu fyrst mælingagagnagrunn eða möppu með myndskurðum (PNGs).

records.key: Choose explicit variables, groups and filters.
records.source: Choose explicit variables, groups and filters.
records.translation: Veldu skýrar breytur, hópa og síur.

records.key: Choose feature columns and inspect representative crops.
records.source: Choose feature columns and inspect representative crops.
records.translation: Veldu eiginleikadálka og skoðaðu dæmigerða myndskurði.

records.key: Choose grouping variables and measurement columns, then inspect pivot tables and groupwise sample sizes.
records.source: Choose grouping variables and measurement columns, then inspect pivot tables and groupwise sample sizes.
records.translation: Veldu flokkunarbreytur og mælingadálka og skoðaðu svo veltitöflur og úrtaksstærðir eftir hópum.

records.key: Choose how the channels are encoded, then press Embed. The table fills with the first few dimensions of each object.
records.source: Choose how the channels are encoded, then press Embed. The table fills with the first few dimensions of each object.
records.translation: Veldu hvernig rásirnar eru kóðaðar og ýttu svo á Fella inn. Taflan fyllist af fyrstu víddum hvers hlutar.

records.key: Choose independent annotation columns for the same objects.
records.source: Choose independent annotation columns for the same objects.
records.translation: Veldu óháða merkingadálka fyrir sömu hluti.

records.key: Choose the image or tabular family to match your input.
records.source: Choose the image or tabular family to match your input.
records.translation: Veldu mynda- eða töflufjölskylduna sem passar við inntakið.

records.key: Choose variables, groups and plotting settings from the loaded table, then export the figure with its analysis context.
records.source: Choose variables, groups and plotting settings from the loaded table, then export the figure with its analysis context.
records.translation: Veldu breytur, hópa og teiknistillingar úr hlaðinni töflu og fluttu svo út myndina ásamt greiningarsamhengi hennar.

records.key: Click a well on the figure or a row in the table.
records.source: Click a well on the figure or a row in the table.
records.translation: Smelltu á brunn á myndinni eða röð í töflunni.

records.key: Close this window. A measurement already running is stopped.
records.source: Close this window. A measurement already running is stopped.
records.translation: Lokaðu þessum glugga. Mæling sem þegar er í gangi er stöðvuð.

records.key: Combine measured objects with matching tracks.
records.source: Combine measured objects with matching tracks.
records.translation: Sameinaðu mælda hluti við samsvarandi ferla.

records.key: Compare compatible saved result sets and their settings.
records.source: Compare compatible saved result sets and their settings.
records.translation: Berðu saman samrýmanleg vistuð niðurstöðusöfn og stillingar þeirra.

records.key: Compare compatible saved settings, counts and hit lists without treating changed input data as a controlled model comparison.
records.source: Compare compatible saved settings, counts and hit lists without treating changed input data as a controlled model comparison.
records.translation: Berðu saman samrýmanlegar vistaðar stillingar, talningar og lista marktækra niðurstaðna án þess að meðhöndla breytt inntaksgögn sem stýrðan samanburð líkana.

records.key: Compare designated controls across plates and inspect drift; the definition of a control comes from the experiment.
records.source: Compare designated controls across plates and inspect drift; the definition of a control comes from the experiment.
records.translation: Berðu saman tilgreind viðmið milli platna og skoðaðu rek; skilgreining viðmiðs kemur frá tilrauninni.

records.key: Compare groups in small-multiple plots with explicit shared or independent axes.
records.source: Compare groups in small-multiple plots with explicit shared or independent axes.
records.translation: Berðu saman hópa í smágrafaröðum með skýrum sameiginlegum eða óháðum ásum.

records.key: Compare independent annotation columns and inspect discordant objects; agreement is separate from classification accuracy.
records.source: Compare independent annotation columns and inspect discordant objects; agreement is separate from classification accuracy.
records.translation: Berðu saman óháða merkingadálka og skoðaðu ósamræmda hluti; samræmi er aðskilið frá nákvæmni flokkunar.

records.key: Compare model masks on identical fields. Without independent reference labels, agreement does not measure segmentation accuracy.
records.source: Compare model masks on identical fields. Without independent reference labels, agreement does not measure segmentation accuracy.
records.translation: Berðu saman grímur líkana á sömu sjónsviðum. Án óháðra viðmiðunarmerkja mælir samræmi ekki nákvæmni hlutunar.

records.key: Compare saved training histories, metrics and settings from compatible model runs.
records.source: Compare saved training histories, metrics and settings from compatible model runs.
records.translation: Berðu saman vistaðar þjálfunarsögur, mælikvarða og stillingar úr samrýmanlegum líkanakeyrslum.

records.key: Comparison tables and figures from compatible saved runs or masks; agreement is not ground-truth accuracy.
records.source: Comparison tables and figures from compatible saved runs or masks; agreement is not ground-truth accuracy.
records.translation: Samanburðartöflur og myndir úr samrýmanlegum vistuðum keyrslum eða grímum; samræmi er ekki nákvæmni miðað við rétt svör.

records.key: Conditions proposed again with the new text settings.
records.source: Conditions proposed again with the new text settings.
records.translation: Aðstæður lagðar til aftur með nýju textastillingunum.

records.key: Confirm annotations is on: the run measures ONLY the images ticked OK below and saved with Save annotations. Every other image is left out.
records.source: Confirm annotations is on: the run measures ONLY the images ticked OK below and saved with Save annotations. Every other image is left out.
records.translation: Staðfesta merkingar er virkt: keyrslan mælir AÐEINS myndirnar sem hakað er við sem OK hér fyrir neðan og vistaðar með Vista merkingar. Öllum öðrum myndum er sleppt.

records.key: Confirm every suggestion on this page you have not judged yet. Undoable with U.
records.source: Confirm every suggestion on this page you have not judged yet. Undoable with U.
records.translation: Staðfesta allar tillögur á þessari síðu sem þú hefur ekki metið enn. Afturkallanlegt með U.

records.key: Convert supported microscope formats to a configured TIFF layout while preserving source mappings. Conversion does not generate object measurements.
records.source: Convert supported microscope formats to a configured TIFF layout while preserving source mappings. Conversion does not generate object measurements.
records.translation: Umbreyttu studdum smásjársniðum í stillta TIFF-uppsetningu og varðveittu varpanir upprunans. Umbreyting býr ekki til mælingar á hlutum.

records.key: Correct labels and track assignments while retaining a record of the edits.
records.source: Correct labels and track assignments while retaining a record of the edits.
records.translation: Leiðréttu merki og úthlutun ferla og haltu jafnframt skrá yfir breytingarnar.

records.key: Could not file the issue: the reporter would not start.
records.source: Could not file the issue: the reporter would not start.
records.translation: Gat ekki skráð málið: tilkynningartólið vildi ekki ræsast.

records.key: Count how many image names in the source folder this convention can read, and show the first one it cannot. Nothing is changed and nothing is written.
records.source: Count how many image names in the source folder this convention can read, and show the first one it cannot. Nothing is changed and nothing is written.
records.translation: Telja hve mörg myndaheiti í upprunamöppunni þessi venja getur lesið og sýna það fyrsta sem hún getur ekki lesið. Engu er breytt og ekkert er skrifað.

records.key: Curate image/mask pairs for segmentation training, or use FEATURES to assign images and masks and invoke measurement. Saving a mask does not train a classifier.
records.source: Curate image/mask pairs for segmentation training, or use FEATURES to assign images and masks and invoke measurement. Saving a mask does not train a classifier.
records.translation: Veldu pör mynda/gríma fyrir þjálfun hlutunar, eða notaðu FEATURES til að úthluta myndum og grímum og kalla á mælingu. Vistun grímu þjálfar ekki flokkara.

records.key: Cut an object with two centres in two, at the ridge between them, on the distance to the background. It is the Otsu category's own split offered to every other method. The Otsu mode is not affected by this box and keeps using its own: applying both would join what Otsu had just separated and cut it again.
records.source: Cut an object with two centres in two, at the ridge between them, on the distance to the background. It is the Otsu category's own split offered to every other method. The Otsu mode is not affected by this box and keeps using its own: applying both would join what Otsu had just separated and cut it again.
records.translation: Skera hlut með tvær miðjur í tvennt, við hrygginn á milli þeirra, eftir fjarlægð frá bakgrunni. Þetta er eigin skipting Otsu-flokksins sem boðin er öllum öðrum aðferðum. Otsu-hamurinn verður ekki fyrir áhrifum af þessum reit og heldur áfram að nota sína eigin: að beita báðum myndi tengja það sem Otsu var nýbúið að aðskilja og skera það aftur.

records.key: Define the class comparison and inspect filtering.
records.source: Define the class comparison and inspect filtering.
records.translation: Skilgreindu samanburð flokka og skoðaðu síun.

records.key: Delete the selected backend's environment and everything downloaded into it. spaCR's own environment is not touched.
records.source: Delete the selected backend's environment and everything downloaded into it. spaCR's own environment is not touched.
records.translation: Eyða umhverfi valins bakenda og öllu sem sótt hefur verið í það. Eigið umhverfi spaCR er ekki snert.

records.key: Detecting dark objects? Turn on Invert image, in the Display category. It inverts the picture you see AND the pixels these buttons and the Live magnifier read, because those were two switches until 2026-09-20 and a curator could have either one without the other.
records.source: Detecting dark objects? Turn on Invert image, in the Display category. It inverts the picture you see AND the pixels these buttons and the Live magnifier read, because those were two switches until 2026-09-20 and a curator could have either one without the other.
records.translation: Ertu að greina dökka hluti? Kveiktu á Snúa við mynd, í flokknum Birting. Það snýr við myndinni sem þú sérð OG pixlunum sem þessir hnappar og Lifandi stækkunargler lesa, því þetta voru tveir rofar fram til 2026-09-20 og sá sem valdi gögn gat haft annan án hins.

records.key: Detector inference sizes, comma separated. Each size is asked and the boxes are merged.
records.source: Detector inference sizes, comma separated. Each size is asked and the boxes are merged.
records.translation: Ályktunarstærðir skynjara, aðskildar með kommu. Spurt er með hverri stærð og kassarnir sameinaðir.

records.key: Display plane changed; Run preview to read it.
records.source: Display plane changed; Run preview to read it.
records.translation: Birtingarplani breytt; Keyrðu forskoðun til að lesa það.

records.key: Done: {total} plaques in the {n} well(s) segmented so far.
records.source: Done: {total} plaques in the {n} well(s) segmented so far.
records.translation: Lokið: {total} skellur í þeim {n} brunni/brunnum sem hafa verið hlutaðir hingað til.

records.key: Double-click to enter a value for this well. Clear it to use the settings or detected ruler.
records.source: Double-click to enter a value for this well. Clear it to use the settings or detected ruler.
records.translation: Tvísmelltu til að slá inn gildi fyrir þennan brunn. Hreinsaðu það til að nota stillingarnar eða greinda kvarðann.

records.key: Download about 390 MB from a published optical pooled screen: two sequencing fields of one well, all eleven cycles, and the guide library. The source, output folder, library and plate are filled in, so Run is the next action. There are no phenotype images, so the phenotype step is skipped. Cached afterwards.
records.source: Download about 390 MB from a published optical pooled screen: two sequencing fields of one well, all eleven cycles, and the guide library. The source, output folder, library and plate are filled in, so Run is the next action. There are no phenotype images, so the phenotype step is skipped. Cached afterwards.
records.translation: Sækja um 390 MB úr birtri ljósfræðilegri samsafnsskimun: tvö raðgreiningarsjónsvið úr einum brunni, allar ellefu umferðirnar og leiðarasafnið. Uppruni, úttaksmappa, safn og plata eru fyllt út, svo Keyra er næsta skref. Engar svipgerðarmyndir eru með, svo svipgerðarskrefinu er sleppt. Geymt í skyndiminni eftir á.

records.key: Download about {size} MB of real THP-1 RNF213 microscopy: two fields with host and vacuole masks, 164 measured hosts and 97 vacuoles. Automatic masks were reconciled by Measure; they are not manual ground truth. RNF213 recruitment uses channel 1. Individual-parasite counts are unavailable, so replication remains unknown. Settings are filled in; choose Live or Run. Cached after the first download.
records.source: Download about {size} MB of real THP-1 RNF213 microscopy: two fields with host and vacuole masks, 164 measured hosts and 97 vacuoles. Automatic masks were reconciled by Measure; they are not manual ground truth. RNF213 recruitment uses channel 1. Individual-parasite counts are unavailable, so replication remains unknown. Settings are filled in; choose Live or Run. Cached after the first download.
records.translation: Sækja um {size} MB af raunverulegum THP-1 RNF213 smásjármyndum: tvö sjónsvið með grímum hýsla og safabóla, 164 mældir hýslar og 97 safabólur. Sjálfvirkar grímur voru samræmdar af Mælingu; þær eru ekki handgerð rétt svör. Söfnun RNF213 notar rás 1. Talning einstakra sníkjudýra er ekki tiltæk, svo fjölgun er áfram óþekkt. Stillingar eru fylltar út; veldu Beint eða Keyra. Geymt í skyndiminni eftir fyrsta niðurhal.

records.key: Download nine overlapping tiles from a published optical pooled screen (about 200 MB) and fill in the tile folder, grid, order and overlap, so Plan can be pressed straight away. Cached after the first download.
records.source: Download nine overlapping tiles from a published optical pooled screen (about 200 MB) and fill in the tile folder, grid, order and overlap, so Plan can be pressed straight away. Cached after the first download.
records.translation: Sækja níu skarandi reiti úr birtri ljósfræðilegri samsafnsskimun (um 200 MB) og fylla út reitamöppu, grind, röð og skörun, svo hægt sé að ýta strax á Áætlun. Geymt í skyndiminni eftir fyrsta niðurhal.

records.key: Download ten example fields for Plaque Analysis and point src at them. Two sets to choose from: segmented plaque fields, which is what the plaque model was trained on, or whole plate figures, which is what the pipeline takes. Cached after the first download.
records.source: Download ten example fields for Plaque Analysis and point src at them. Two sets to choose from: segmented plaque fields, which is what the plaque model was trained on, or whole plate figures, which is what the pipeline takes. Cached after the first download.
records.translation: Sækja tíu dæmasjónsvið fyrir skellugreiningu og beina src á þau. Tvö söfn til að velja úr: hlutuð skellusjónsvið, sem skellulíkanið var þjálfað á, eða myndir af heilum plötum, sem vinnsluferlið tekur við. Geymt í skyndiminni eftir fyrsta niðurhal.

records.key: Downloaded {name}, but the folder would not open
records.source: Downloaded {name}, but the folder would not open
records.translation: Sótti {name}, en mappan vildi ekki opnast

records.key: Draft methods/results text from recorded settings and results; review every claim before publication.
records.source: Draft methods/results text from recorded settings and results; review every claim before publication.
records.translation: Drög að texta um aðferðir/niðurstöður út frá skráðum stillingum og niðurstöðum; yfirfarðu hverja fullyrðingu fyrir birtingu.

records.key: Drag a line on the image to measure it in image pixels, and in microns when the pixel size is known: Pixels per µm in the settings' Scale & Time, or a well's own value in the Wells table. Right-click with Ruler selected to clear the line. Turn Ruler off to pan or to pick a well.
records.source: Drag a line on the image to measure it in image pixels, and in microns when the pixel size is known: Pixels per µm in the settings' Scale & Time, or a well's own value in the Wells table. Right-click with Ruler selected to clear the line. Turn Ruler off to pan or to pick a well.
records.translation: Dragðu línu á myndina til að mæla hana í pixlum myndarinnar, og í míkronum þegar pixlastærðin er þekkt: Pixlar á µm í KVARÐI OG TÍMI í stillingunum, eða eigið gildi brunns í brunnatöflunni. Hægrismelltu með Reglustiku valda til að hreinsa línuna. Slökktu á Reglustiku til að hliðra eða velja brunn.

records.key: Drop a folder of images anywhere on this window or type a path into the Source field below. Use Load test data when available, or open Pipeline overviews on Home to choose a walkthrough.
records.source: Drop a folder of images anywhere on this window or type a path into the Source field below. Use Load test data when available, or open Pipeline overviews on Home to choose a walkthrough.
records.translation: Dragðu möppu með myndum hvert sem er á þennan glugga eða sláðu inn slóð í Uppruna-reitinn hér fyrir neðan. Notaðu Hlaða prófunargögnum þegar það er í boði, eða opnaðu Yfirlit vinnslukeðja á Heimaskjánum til að velja yfirferð.

records.key: Each src project root/measurements/measurements.db; tables defaults to cell, nucleus, pathogen and cytoplasm, with png_list added for merging. The compartment setting selects the area column; default pathogen_area is summed per host cell.
records.source: Each src project root/measurements/measurements.db; tables defaults to cell, nucleus, pathogen and cytoplasm, with png_list added for merging. The compartment setting selects the area column; default pathogen_area is summed per host cell.
records.translation: measurements/measurements.db í hverri verkefnisrót src; töflur eru sjálfgefið cell, nucleus, pathogen og cytoplasm, með png_list bætt við fyrir sameiningu. Stillingin compartment velur flatarmálsdálkinn; sjálfgefið er pathogen_area lagt saman fyrir hverja hýsilfrumu.

records.key: Enable the nested time-series route before generating linked labels.
records.source: Enable the nested time-series route before generating linked labels.
records.translation: Virkjaðu hreiðruðu tímaraðarleiðina áður en tengd merki eru búin til.

records.key: Encode object images with a chosen model and channel policy. Retain object identities and encoder provenance when supplying the features to downstream exploration.
records.source: Encode object images with a chosen model and channel policy. Retain object identities and encoder provenance when supplying the features to downstream exploration.
records.translation: Kóðaðu myndir af hlutum með völdu líkani og rásareglu. Varðveittu auðkenni hluta og uppruna kóðara þegar eiginleikarnir eru afhentir til áframhaldandi könnunar.

records.key: Enter a finite positive scale, or a nonnegative formation time in hours. Clear the cell to restore its default.
records.source: Enter a finite positive scale, or a nonnegative formation time in hours. Clear the cell to restore its default.
records.translation: Sláðu inn endanlegan jákvæðan kvarða, eða myndunartíma í klukkustundum sem er ekki neikvæður. Hreinsaðu reitinn til að endurheimta sjálfgildið.

records.key: Enter conditions, controls, replicates and plate constraints, then export the experimental layout before acquisition.
records.source: Enter conditions, controls, replicates and plate constraints, then export the experimental layout before acquisition.
records.translation: Sláðu inn aðstæður, viðmið, endurtekningar og takmarkanir platna og fluttu svo út tilraunauppsetninguna fyrir myndatöku.

records.key: Epithelial invasion is planned to distinguish extracellular fungi from those internalised by epithelial cells. Phagocytosis will measure uptake by phagocytes. Both require a way to resolve contact from internalisation, such as appropriate differential labelling or spatial information. Report the host-cell population and fungal morphology together with the uptake readout.
records.source: Epithelial invasion is planned to distinguish extracellular fungi from those internalised by epithelial cells. Phagocytosis will measure uptake by phagocytes. Both require a way to resolve contact from internalisation, such as appropriate differential labelling or spatial information. Report the host-cell population and fungal morphology together with the uptake readout.
records.translation: Fyrirhugað er að innrás í þekjuvef greini á milli sveppa utan frumna og þeirra sem þekjufrumur hafa tekið inn. Átfrumuát mun mæla upptöku átfrumna. Hvort tveggja krefst leiðar til að greina snertingu frá upptöku, svo sem viðeigandi mismunamerkingar eða rúmfræðilegra upplýsinga. Tilgreindu hýsilfrumuþýðið og formfræði sveppanna ásamt upptökumælingunni.

records.key: Equalise the histogram inside each tile rather than over the whole field, with a limit on how much any one level may be stretched. It is what brings out objects in a dim corner without blowing out the bright middle. It also amplifies noise in empty tiles, which is what the clip limit is for.
records.source: Equalise the histogram inside each tile rather than over the whole field, with a limit on how much any one level may be stretched. It is what brings out objects in a dim corner without blowing out the bright middle. It also amplifies noise in empty tiles, which is what the clip limit is for.
records.translation: Jafna stuðlaritið innan hvers reits frekar en yfir allt sjónsviðið, með takmörkun á hve mikið hvert stig má teygja. Þetta dregur fram hluti í dimmu horni án þess að sprengja bjarta miðjuna. Það magnar einnig suð í tómum reitum, og til þess eru klippimörkin.

records.key: Estimate and apply flat-field correction at configured stages. Keep corrected display values distinct from raw measurements and record the applied policy.
records.source: Estimate and apply flat-field correction at configured stages. Keep corrected display values distinct from raw measurements and record the applied policy.
records.translation: Mettu og beittu flatsviðsleiðréttingu á stilltum stigum. Haltu leiðréttum birtingargildum aðskildum frá hráum mælingum og skráðu regluna sem var beitt.

records.key: Estimate sampling needs from chosen effect sizes and variability; pilot measurements are optional evidence for assumptions.
records.source: Estimate sampling needs from chosen effect sizes and variability; pilot measurements are optional evidence for assumptions.
records.translation: Mettu þörf á úrtaki út frá völdum áhrifastærðum og breytileika; forkönnunarmælingar eru valfrjáls rök fyrir forsendum.

records.key: Everything here is off until you switch sound on. The sounds are made by spaCR on this computer, nothing is recorded or downloaded, and they play on a thread of their own, so a missing or busy audio device only ever means silence.
records.source: Everything here is off until you switch sound on. The sounds are made by spaCR on this computer, nothing is recorded or downloaded, and they play on a thread of their own, so a missing or busy audio device only ever means silence.
records.translation: Allt hér er óvirkt þar til þú kveikir á hljóði. Hljóðin eru búin til af spaCR á þessari tölvu, ekkert er tekið upp eða sótt, og þau spila á eigin þræði, svo hljóðtæki sem vantar eða er upptekið þýðir aðeins þögn.

records.key: Explore the apicomplexan cell using Starplast's Toxoplasma hyperLOPIT labels. Hover for a location description, check several compartments to keep them highlighted, or use Clear components to reset them. Several classes share a shape; dense granules use the generic cytoplasmic-granule shape. Ribosomes, proteasomes, apical classes and mixed endomembrane vesicles have no matching shape here. The illustration shows compartment names, not protein measurements.
records.source: Explore the apicomplexan cell using Starplast's Toxoplasma hyperLOPIT labels. Hover for a location description, check several compartments to keep them highlighted, or use Clear components to reset them. Several classes share a shape; dense granules use the generic cytoplasmic-granule shape. Ribosomes, proteasomes, apical classes and mixed endomembrane vesicles have no matching shape here. The illustration shows compartment names, not protein measurements.
records.translation: Kannaðu Apicomplexa-frumuna með Toxoplasma hyperLOPIT-merkjum Starplast. Haltu bendlinum yfir til að sjá lýsingu á staðsetningu, hakaðu við nokkur hólf til að halda þeim auðkenndum, eða notaðu Hreinsa val til að endurstilla þau. Nokkrir flokkar deila lögun; þétt korn nota almennu lögun umfrymiskorna. Ríbósóm, próteasóm, toppflokkar og blandaðar innhimnublöðrur hafa enga samsvarandi lögun hér. Myndin sýnir heiti hólfa, ekki mælingar á próteinum.

records.key: Export an AnnData .h5ad file with object metadata and measured features for downstream single-cell analysis.
records.source: Export an AnnData .h5ad file with object metadata and measured features for downstream single-cell analysis.
records.translation: Flyttu út AnnData .h5ad-skrá með lýsigögnum hluta og mældum eiginleikum fyrir áframhaldandi greiningu einstakra frumna.

records.key: Export compatible feature and metadata columns.
records.source: Export compatible feature and metadata columns.
records.translation: Flyttu út samrýmanlega eiginleika- og lýsigagnadálka.

records.key: Exported HTML/PDF or methods/results documents derived from recorded analysis outputs.
records.source: Exported HTML/PDF or methods/results documents derived from recorded analysis outputs.
records.translation: Útflutt HTML/PDF eða aðferða-/niðurstöðuskjöl unnin úr skráðum greiningarúttökum.

records.key: Exported plate/condition/control/replicate map. Keep its plate and well identifiers consistent with the acquired data.
records.source: Exported plate/condition/control/replicate map. Keep its plate and well identifiers consistent with the acquired data.
records.translation: Útflutt kort platna/aðstæðna/viðmiða/endurtekninga. Haltu auðkennum platna og brunna í samræmi við myndgögnin.

records.key: Fetch a paper's figures and legends by DOI, PMID, PMC id or PDF into a new folder, and preview them.
records.source: Fetch a paper's figures and legends by DOI, PMID, PMC id or PDF into a new folder, and preview them.
records.translation: Sækja myndir og myndatexta greinar eftir DOI, PMID, PMC-auðkenni eða PDF í nýja möppu og forskoða þær.

records.key: Figure mode needs {names}. Press Install to put them in an environment of their own, so spaCR's own packages are not changed. Plaque mode works without them.
records.source: Figure mode needs {names}. Press Install to put them in an environment of their own, so spaCR's own packages are not changed. Plaque mode works without them.
records.translation: Figure-hamur þarf {names}. Ýttu á Setja upp til að setja þau í sérstakt umhverfi, svo eigin pökkum spaCR sé ekki breytt. Skelluhamur virkar án þeirra.

records.key: Figure mode: a folder of published figures. The run finds the plaque images in each figure, reads the text around them to name each condition, and segments the plaques.
records.source: Figure mode: a folder of published figures. The run finds the plaque images in each figure, reads the text around them to name each condition, and segments the plaques.
records.translation: Figure-hamur: mappa með birtum myndum úr greinum. Keyrslan finnur skellumyndirnar í hverri mynd, les textann í kringum þær til að nefna hverjar aðstæður og hlutar skellurnar.

records.key: Filamentation is planned to quantify the frequency and extent of filament growth. Germ tube formation will focus on early outgrowth from individual cells, and Morphology will distinguish yeast, pseudohyphal and hyphal forms where those categories apply. These related modules address different points in a morphological transition. Use species-appropriate reference images and record the growth conditions when comparing their results.
records.source: Filamentation is planned to quantify the frequency and extent of filament growth. Germ tube formation will focus on early outgrowth from individual cells, and Morphology will distinguish yeast, pseudohyphal and hyphal forms where those categories apply. These related modules address different points in a morphological transition. Use species-appropriate reference images and record the growth conditions when comparing their results.
records.translation: Fyrirhugað er að Filamentation magngreini tíðni og umfang þráðavaxtar. Germ tube formation mun beinast að fyrsta útvexti frá einstökum frumum, og Morphology mun greina á milli gers-, gervisveppþráða- og sveppþráðaforma þar sem þeir flokkar eiga við. Þessar skyldu einingar fjalla um ólíka punkta í formbreytingu. Notaðu viðmiðunarmyndir sem henta tegundinni og skráðu vaxtarskilyrði þegar niðurstöður þeirra eru bornar saman.

records.key: Files that were dropped but matched no row and column. Nothing here is measured.
records.source: Files that were dropped but matched no row and column. Nothing here is measured.
records.translation: Skrár sem dregnar voru inn en pössuðu við enga röð og dálk. Ekkert hér er mælt.

records.key: Filter and rank saved hits with their effects, FDR and guide agreement.
records.source: Filter and rank saved hits with their effects, FDR and guide agreement.
records.translation: Síaðu og raðaðu vistuðum marktækum niðurstöðum eftir áhrifum, FDR og samræmi leiðara.

records.key: Find the plaques in every well found on this figure, one after another. Cancel stops after the well in progress.
records.source: Find the plaques in every well found on this figure, one after another. Cancel stops after the well in progress.
records.translation: Finna skellurnar í öllum brunnum sem fundust á þessari mynd, einum af öðrum. Hætta við stöðvar eftir brunninn sem er í vinnslu.

records.key: Find the plaques in the highlighted well with the plaque settings.
records.source: Find the plaques in the highlighted well with the plaque settings.
records.translation: Finna skellurnar í auðkennda brunninum með skellustillingunum.

records.key: Finding plaques in well {n} ({k} of {total})…
records.source: Finding plaques in well {n} ({k} of {total})…
records.translation: Leita að skellum í brunni {n} ({k} af {total})…

records.key: Finish or stop the active analyses before updating spaCR.
records.source: Finish or stop the active analyses before updating spaCR.
records.translation: Ljúktu við eða stöðvaðu virkar greiningar áður en spaCR er uppfært.

records.key: Finish signing in to {label} in the window that opened, then press Done.
records.source: Finish signing in to {label} in the window that opened, then press Done.
records.translation: Ljúktu innskráningu í {label} í glugganum sem opnaðist og ýttu svo á Lokið.

records.key: Fit a measured-feature surrogate to existing computer-vision scores, preserving identity joins. A surrogate explanation is not causality.
records.source: Fit a measured-feature surrogate to existing computer-vision scores, preserving identity joins. A surrogate explanation is not causality.
records.translation: Mátaðu staðgengil úr mældum eiginleikum við fyrirliggjandi skor tölvusjónar og varðveittu tengingar auðkenna. Útskýring staðgengils sýnir ekki orsakasamhengi.

records.key: Flatten the histogram of the whole region at once, so every brightness band ends up with the same number of pixels. It is the strongest of the contrast steps and the least respectful of the data: a field that is mostly background has its background stretched across half the range.
records.source: Flatten the histogram of the whole region at once, so every brightness band ends up with the same number of pixels. It is the strongest of the contrast steps and the least respectful of the data: a field that is mostly background has its background stretched across half the range.
records.translation: Fletja út stuðlarit alls svæðisins í einu, svo hvert birtubil fái jafnmarga pixla. Þetta er sterkasta skrefið í birtuskerpu og það sem virðir gögnin minnst: sjónsvið sem er að mestu bakgrunnur fær bakgrunninn teygðan yfir helming bilsins.

records.key: GUI-only compartment highlights and navigation to available assays; no measurements or files are produced.
records.source: GUI-only compartment highlights and navigation to available assays; no measurements or files are produced.
records.translation: Áherslur á hólf og leiðsögn að tiltækum prófum eingöngu í GUI; engar mælingar eða skrár verða til.

records.key: Gametocyte maturity is a proposed workflow for stage and sex-associated image features when suitable markers and reference annotations are available. Drug response imaging will relate growth and morphology to concentration. Record the species, starting stage and exposure duration with these measurements: changes in the mix of stages can otherwise be mistaken for changes in parasite number.
records.source: Gametocyte maturity is a proposed workflow for stage and sex-associated image features when suitable markers and reference annotations are available. Drug response imaging will relate growth and morphology to concentration. Record the species, starting stage and exposure duration with these measurements: changes in the mix of stages can otherwise be mistaken for changes in parasite number.
records.translation: Þroski kynfrumumóðurfrumna er fyrirhugað verkflæði fyrir myndeiginleika tengda stigi og kyni þegar viðeigandi merki og viðmiðunarmerkingar eru tiltæk. Myndgreining á lyfjasvörun mun tengja vöxt og formfræði við styrk. Skráðu tegund, upphafsstig og lengd útsetningar með þessum mælingum: annars getur breyting á samsetningu stiga verið tekin fyrir breytingu á fjölda sníkjudýra.

records.key: Gaussian blur applied before the centres are found, in pixels. It is what makes ONE object have ONE centre: a raw object has a dozen maxima in its own noise. About a third of the object radius is a starting point. This is NOT the Image enhancement card's denoise, which has already run by now; leave that one off unless the field is genuinely noisy, or the two blurs compound.
records.source: Gaussian blur applied before the centres are found, in pixels. It is what makes ONE object have ONE centre: a raw object has a dozen maxima in its own noise. About a third of the object radius is a starting point. This is NOT the Image enhancement card's denoise, which has already run by now; leave that one off unless the field is genuinely noisy, or the two blurs compound.
records.translation: Gauss-þoka sem beitt er áður en miðjurnar finnast, í pixlum. Hún er það sem gefur EINUM hlut EINA miðju: hrár hlutur hefur tugi hágilda í eigin suði. Um þriðjungur af radíus hlutarins er upphafspunktur. Þetta er EKKI suðhreinsun Myndbætingar-spjaldsins, sem hefur þegar keyrt á þessum tímapunkti; hafðu hana óvirka nema sjónsviðið sé raunverulega suðótt, annars leggjast þokurnar tvær saman.

records.key: Grow a watershed from each blob centre instead of stamping a disk whose radius comes from that blob's own scale. Turn it off when single spots are being fragmented.
records.source: Grow a watershed from each blob centre instead of stamping a disk whose radius comes from that blob's own scale. Turn it off when single spots are being fragmented.
records.translation: Láta vatnaskil vaxa frá miðju hvers bletts í stað þess að stimpla disk þar sem radíusinn kemur frá eigin kvarða blettsins. Slökktu á þessu þegar stakir blettir brotna upp.

records.key: Heavy: {steps}. A whole-image run shows progress and can be cancelled.
records.source: Heavy: {steps}. A whole-image run shows progress and can be cancelled.
records.translation: Þungt: {steps}. Keyrsla á allri myndinni sýnir framvindu og hægt er að hætta við hana.

records.key: Held-out predictions, labels, split metadata and calibration/leakage metrics for a saved classifier run.
records.source: Held-out predictions, labels, split metadata and calibration/leakage metrics for a saved classifier run.
records.translation: Spár á útilokuðum gögnum, merki, lýsigögn skiptingar og mælikvarðar á kvörðun/leka fyrir vistaða flokkarakeyrslu.

records.key: Hold {key} and scroll to zoom; drag the image to pan.
records.source: Hold {key} and scroll to zoom; drag the image to pan.
records.translation: Haltu {key} niðri og skrunaðu til að þysja; dragðu myndina til að hliðra.

records.key: Holes inside an object smaller than this are filled, so an object dimmer in the middle than at its rim does not come back as a ring. 0 leaves every hole where it is.
records.source: Holes inside an object smaller than this are filled, so an object dimmer in the middle than at its rim does not come back as a ring. 0 leaves every hole where it is.
records.translation: Göt inni í hlut sem eru minni en þetta eru fyllt, svo hlutur sem er daufari í miðjunni en við jaðarinn komi ekki út sem hringur. 0 skilur öll göt eftir þar sem þau eru.

records.key: Hover a button to see which microscope format and file naming it tests. The first press downloads every variant at once, about 285 MB; later presses open from the cache. Nothing is written into a project until you press Import.
records.source: Hover a button to see which microscope format and file naming it tests. The first press downloads every variant at once, about 285 MB; later presses open from the cache. Nothing is written into a project until you press Import.
records.translation: Haltu bendlinum yfir hnappi til að sjá hvaða smásjársnið og skráanafngift hann prófar. Fyrsta ýting sækir öll afbrigðin í einu, um 285 MB; síðari ýtingar opna úr skyndiminni. Ekkert er skrifað í verkefni fyrr en þú ýtir á Flytja inn.

records.key: How bright a maximum has to be to count as a centre. Read as a percentile of the blurred image by default, so one setting suits any exposure: 90 means the top tenth of the pixels. This and the distance together decide HOW MANY objects there will be, and the status line says how many centres were found.
records.source: How bright a maximum has to be to count as a centre. Read as a percentile of the blurred image by default, so one setting suits any exposure: 90 means the top tenth of the pixels. This and the distance together decide HOW MANY objects there will be, and the status line says how many centres were found.
records.translation: Hversu bjart hágildi þarf að vera til að teljast miðja. Lesið sjálfgefið sem hundraðsmark þokuðu myndarinnar, svo ein stilling hentar hvaða lýsingartíma sem er: 90 þýðir efsti tíundi hluti pixlanna. Þetta og fjarlægðin ákveða saman HVE MARGIR hlutirnir verða, og stöðulínan segir hve margar miðjur fundust.

records.key: How loud every spaCR sound is, from silent to full. The music bed always plays quieter than the other sounds.
records.source: How loud every spaCR sound is, from silent to full. The music bed always plays quieter than the other sounds.
records.translation: Hversu hátt öll hljóð spaCR eru, frá hljóðlausu upp í fullan styrk. Bakgrunnstónlistin spilar alltaf lægra en hin hljóðin.

records.key: How many intensity channels each field has. One column is added per channel, and the channel numbering of the merged array follows the column order.
records.source: How many intensity channels each field has. One column is added per channel, and the channel numbering of the merged array follows the column order.
records.translation: Hversu margar styrkrásir hvert sjónsvið hefur. Einum dálki er bætt við fyrir hverja rás og rásanúmer sameinaða fylkisins fylgja röð dálkanna.

records.key: How many of the matching crops to load. The rest are counted and named, not silently dropped.
records.source: How many of the matching crops to load. The rest are counted and named, not silently dropped.
records.translation: Hversu mörgum samsvarandi myndskurðum á að hlaða. Hinir eru taldir og nefndir, ekki felldir niður í hljóði.

records.key: How many scales are evaluated between the two sigmas. More resolves a wider spread of spot sizes and costs one filter pass each; 3 to 5 is enough when the spots are all one size.
records.source: How many scales are evaluated between the two sigmas. More resolves a wider spread of spot sizes and costs one filter pass each; 3 to 5 is enough when the spots are all one size.
records.translation: Hve margir kvarðar eru metnir milli sigmanna tveggja. Fleiri greina breiðara úrval blettastærða og kosta eina síuumferð hver; 3 til 5 duga þegar blettirnir eru allir jafnstórir.

records.key: How much contrast a tile may be given, 0 to 1. Higher is more contrast and more amplified noise in tiles that hold only background.
records.source: How much contrast a tile may be given, 0 to 1. Higher is more contrast and more amplified noise in tiles that hold only background.
records.translation: Hversu mikla birtuskerpu reitur má fá, 0 til 1. Hærra gildi gefur meiri birtuskerpu og meira magnað suð í reitum sem innihalda aðeins bakgrunn.

records.key: How much of the mask is added back. 1 is a normal sharpen; above 2 the halos start to become objects of their own.
records.source: How much of the mask is added back. 1 is a normal sharpen; above 2 the halos start to become objects of their own.
records.translation: Hversu miklu af grímunni er bætt aftur við. 1 er venjuleg skerping; yfir 2 fara geislabaugarnir að verða að sjálfstæðum hlutum.

records.key: How much smoothing: the Gaussian's sigma in pixels, the median's and the bilateral's disk radius, or the non-local means' cut-off in multiples of the noise it measures.
records.source: How much smoothing: the Gaussian's sigma in pixels, the median's and the bilateral's disk radius, or the non-local means' cut-off in multiples of the noise it measures.
records.translation: Hversu mikil mýking: sigma Gauss-fallsins í pixlum, diskradíus miðgildis- og tvíhliða síunnar, eða mörk ekki-staðbundinna meðaltala í margfeldum af suðinu sem hún mælir.

records.key: How the filter's response becomes a foreground. Otsu takes one level for the whole region; Adaptive uses the block size and offset above and keeps faint filaments in dim corners, at the cost of background elsewhere.
records.source: How the filter's response becomes a foreground. Otsu takes one level for the whole region; Adaptive uses the block size and offset above and keeps faint filaments in dim corners, at the cost of background elsewhere.
records.translation: Hvernig svörun síunnar verður að forgrunni. Otsu tekur eitt stig fyrir allt svæðið; Aðlögunarhæft notar blokkastærðina og hliðrunina hér að ofan og heldur daufum þráðum í dimmum hornum, á kostnað bakgrunns annars staðar.

records.key: Image UMAP/PCA coordinate tables, selected clusters and figures for the loaded measurement data.
records.source: Image UMAP/PCA coordinate tables, selected clusters and figures for the loaded measurement data.
records.translation: Hnitatöflur Image UMAP/PCA, valdir klasar og myndir fyrir hlaðin mæligögn.

records.key:
ImageJ TIFF stack, three channels per file, named like E01/field009.tif. Naming: auto. Fills the Import screen: images, cell / nucleus / pathogen masks and a measurements table, then previews.

Channels are read from inside the file.
records.source:
ImageJ TIFF stack, three channels per file, named like E01/field009.tif. Naming: auto. Fills the Import screen: images, cell / nucleus / pathogen masks and a measurements table, then previews.

Channels are read from inside the file.
records.translation:
ImageJ TIFF-stafli, þrjár rásir í hverri skrá, nefnt eins og E01/field009.tif. Nafngift: auto. Fyllir skjáinn Flytja inn: myndir, grímur frumna / kjarna / sýkla og mælingatafla, síðan forskoðun.

Rásir eru lesnar innan úr skránni.

records.key: Imported tables require explicit column and object-identity mappings.
records.source: Imported tables require explicit column and object-identity mappings.
records.translation: Innfluttar töflur krefjast skýrrar vörpunar á dálkum og auðkennum hluta.

records.key: In Mask, choose the image folder for your time series. Enable Timelapse, then configure the time metadata and tracking settings.
records.source: In Mask, choose the image folder for your time series. Enable Timelapse, then configure the time metadata and tracking settings.
records.translation: Í Grímur skaltu velja myndamöppuna fyrir tímaröðina þína. Virkjaðu Tímaraðir og stilltu svo tímalýsigögn og rakningarstillingar.

records.key: Inspect aligned image, label and point/ROI layers for the selected field.
records.source: Inspect aligned image, label and point/ROI layers for the selected field.
records.translation: Skoðaðu jöfnuð lög mynda, merkja og punkta/ROI fyrir valið sjónsvið.

records.key: Inspect held-out predictions, calibration and split/leakage evidence for the matching classifier.
records.source: Inspect held-out predictions, calibration and split/leakage evidence for the matching classifier.
records.translation: Skoðaðu spár á útilokuðum gögnum, kvörðun og vísbendingar um skiptingu/leka fyrir samsvarandi flokkara.

records.key: Inspect how a fitted model responds as an input feature changes; predictions do not establish causal effects.
records.source: Inspect how a fitted model responds as an input feature changes; predictions do not establish causal effects.
records.translation: Skoðaðu hvernig mátað líkan bregst við þegar inntakseiginleiki breytist; spár sýna ekki fram á orsakaáhrif.

records.key: Inspect mapping depth, coverage, collisions and positional effects before guide-count filtering.
records.source: Inspect mapping depth, coverage, collisions and positional effects before guide-count filtering.
records.translation: Skoðaðu dýpt vörpunar, þekju, árekstra og staðsetningaráhrif áður en talning leiðara er síuð.

records.key: Inspect model provenance and download/install compatible checkpoints or backends. A listed backend is not itself a checkpoint file.
records.source: Inspect model provenance and download/install compatible checkpoints or backends. A listed backend is not itself a checkpoint file.
records.translation: Skoðaðu uppruna líkana og sæktu/settu upp samrýmanlega vistunarpunkta eða bakenda. Skráður bakendi er ekki sjálfur vistunarpunktsskrá.

records.key: Inspect principal components and feature loadings for the selected measured objects.
records.source: Inspect principal components and feature loadings for the selected measured objects.
records.translation: Skoðaðu höfuðþætti og hleðslur eiginleika fyrir valda mælda hluti.

records.key: Inspect project files and disk usage. Removing derived artifacts invalidates downstream uses of those files; original images must remain recoverable.
records.source: Inspect project files and disk usage. Removing derived artifacts invalidates downstream uses of those files; original images must remain recoverable.
records.translation: Skoðaðu verkefnisskrár og diskanotkun. Ef afleiddar afurðir eru fjarlægðar ógildir það síðari notkun þeirra skráa; upprunalegar myndir verða að vera endurheimtanlegar.

records.key: Inspect recorded cell/nucleus/pathogen/organelle containment links; this is object containment, not time-series lineage inference.
records.source: Inspect recorded cell/nucleus/pathogen/organelle containment links; this is object containment, not time-series lineage inference.
records.translation: Skoðaðu skráð tengsl um innihald frumna/kjarna/sýkla/frumulíffæra; þetta er innihald hluta, ekki ályktun um ætterni í tímaröð.

records.key: Inspect saved effects and adjusted significance.
records.source: Inspect saved effects and adjusted significance.
records.translation: Skoðaðu vistuð áhrif og leiðrétta marktækni.

records.key: Inspect saved run status, settings, outputs and logs; a completed run does not establish biological validity.
records.source: Inspect saved run status, settings, outputs and logs; a completed run does not establish biological validity.
records.translation: Skoðaðu stöðu, stillingar, úttök og annála vistaðra keyrslna; lokin keyrsla staðfestir ekki líffræðilegt gildi.

records.key: Inspect stored segmentation, unit, leakage and plate-effect checks. Open its nested viewers for detailed inspection.
records.source: Inspect stored segmentation, unit, leakage and plate-effect checks. Open its nested viewers for detailed inspection.
records.translation: Skoðaðu vistaðar athuganir á hlutun, einingum, leka og plötuáhrifum. Opnaðu hreiðraða skoðara þess fyrir ítarlega skoðun.

records.key: Inspect the diagnostic panels saved by the chosen regression run; distinguish missing diagnostics from passed assumptions.
records.source: Inspect the diagnostic panels saved by the chosen regression run; distinguish missing diagnostics from passed assumptions.
records.translation: Skoðaðu greiningarspjöldin sem valin aðhvarfskeyrsla vistaði; greindu á milli greininga sem vantar og forsendna sem stóðust.

records.key: Inspect tile geometry, overlap and channel mapping, then save the mosaic with coordinate records. OPS also needs the original cycle/site identities.
records.source: Inspect tile geometry, overlap and channel mapping, then save the mosaic with coordinate records. OPS also needs the original cycle/site identities.
records.translation: Skoðaðu rúmfræði reita, skörun og rásavörpun og vistaðu svo mósaíkmyndina með hnitaskrám. OPS þarf einnig upprunaleg auðkenni umferða/staðsetninga.

records.key: Inspect track speed and infection-related measurements with an explicit frame interval and pixel calibration.
records.source: Inspect track speed and infection-related measurements with an explicit frame interval and pixel calibration.
records.translation: Skoðaðu hraða ferla og sýkingartengdar mælingar með skýru tímabili milli ramma og pixlakvörðun.

records.key: Install the plaque figure reader (YOLO and RapidOCR) into an environment of its own under ~/.spacr/backends; spaCR's own packages are not changed.
