records.source: Install the plaque figure reader (YOLO and RapidOCR) into an environment of its own under ~/.spacr/backends; spaCR's own packages are not changed.
records.translation: Setja upp myndalesara fyrir skellur (YOLO og RapidOCR) í sérstöku umhverfi undir ~/.spacr/backends; eigin pökkum spaCR er ekki breytt.

records.key: Installed organism descriptions and SwissBioPics cell diagrams; no project input is required.
records.source: Installed organism descriptions and SwissBioPics cell diagrams; no project input is required.
records.translation: Uppsettar lýsingar lífvera og SwissBioPics-frumuskýringarmyndir; ekkert verkefnisinntak er nauðsynlegt.

records.key: Join compatible phenotype and object data for the chosen hit.
records.source: Join compatible phenotype and object data for the chosen hit.
records.translation: Tengdu samrýmanleg svipgerðar- og hlutagögn fyrir valda marktæka niðurstöðu.

records.key: Join the measured response to explicit doses and controls.
records.source: Join the measured response to explicit doses and controls.
records.translation: Tengdu mælda svörun við skýra skammta og viðmið.

records.key: Join/aggregate decoded objects to phenotype and guide inputs explicitly before Regression; this is not a direct CSV handoff.
records.source: Join/aggregate decoded objects to phenotype and guide inputs explicitly before Regression; this is not a direct CSV handoff.
records.translation: Tengdu/taktu saman afkóðaða hluti við svipgerðar- og leiðarainntök skýrt fyrir Aðhvarf; þetta er ekki bein CSV-afhending.

records.key: Judge them one at a time: click or press Y to confirm a suggestion, right-click or press N to reject it.
records.source: Judge them one at a time: click or press Y to confirm a suggestion, right-click or press N to reject it.
records.translation: Mettu þær eina í einu: smelltu eða ýttu á Y til að staðfesta tillögu, hægrismelltu eða ýttu á N til að hafna henni.

records.key: Keep labelled training and evaluation groups separate.
records.source: Keep labelled training and evaluation groups separate.
records.translation: Haltu merktum þjálfunar- og matshópum aðskildum.

records.key: Keep the newly measured project and crop index together.
records.source: Keep the newly measured project and crop index together.
records.translation: Haltu nýmælda verkefninu og myndskurðaskránni saman.

records.key: Keep uninfected cells in Measure. Supply whole-vacuole masks, host reference intensities and optional explicit parasite-to-vacuole links; host identity alone does not define a vacuole.
records.source: Keep uninfected cells in Measure. Supply whole-vacuole masks, host reference intensities and optional explicit parasite-to-vacuole links; host identity alone does not define a vacuole.
records.translation: Haltu ósýktum frumum í Mælingu. Gefðu upp grímur heilla safabóla, viðmiðunarstyrk hýsla og valfrjálsar skýrar tengingar sníkjudýra við safabólur; auðkenni hýsils eitt og sér skilgreinir ekki safabólu.

records.key: Label representative objects in png_list before supervised training. Use separate annotations for different questions and keep training and evaluation groups independent.
records.source: Label representative objects in png_list before supervised training. Use separate annotations for different questions and keep training and evaluation groups independent.
records.translation: Merktu dæmigerða hluti í png_list fyrir stýrða þjálfun. Notaðu aðskildar merkingar fyrir ólíkar spurningar og haltu þjálfunar- og matshópum óháðum.

records.key: Label the centre line of the network instead of the filled filaments, so a measured area tracks network LENGTH rather than filament thickness. Leave it off to measure filament mass.
records.source: Label the centre line of the network instead of the filled filaments, so a measured area tracks network LENGTH rather than filament thickness. Leave it off to measure filament mass.
records.translation: Merkja miðlínu netsins í stað fylltu þráðanna, svo mælt flatarmál fylgi LENGD netsins frekar en þykkt þráða. Hafðu slökkt á þessu til að mæla massa þráða.

records.key: Lay this session's masks and the field over one another, with an opacity and a stacking order for each, in a third panel. The last {count} masks are kept.
records.source: Lay this session's masks and the field over one another, with an opacity and a stacking order for each, in a third panel. The last {count} masks are kept.
records.translation: Leggja grímur þessarar lotu og sjónsviðið hvert yfir annað, með ógagnsæi og staflaröð fyrir hvert, í þriðja spjaldi. Síðustu {count} grímunum er haldið.

records.key: Leave out maxima within one minimum distance of the frame. An object the edge cuts has its centre in the wrong place, so what grows from it is the wrong shape.
records.source: Leave out maxima within one minimum distance of the frame. An object the edge cuts has its centre in the wrong place, so what grows from it is the wrong shape.
records.translation: Sleppa hágildum innan einnar lágmarksfjarlægðar frá rammanum. Hlutur sem jaðarinn sker hefur miðju sína á röngum stað, svo það sem vex út frá henni fær ranga lögun.

records.key:
Leica LIF (public samples), named like A01/FRAP.lif. Naming: auto. Fills the Format Converter: images only, then previews.

No open library writes LIF, so these are public sample files by Sean Warren and Michael Goelzer, CC BY 4.0: time series, a z-stack and a tile scan. They have no masks, so they go through the Format Converter.
records.source:
Leica LIF (public samples), named like A01/FRAP.lif. Naming: auto. Fills the Format Converter: images only, then previews.

No open library writes LIF, so these are public sample files by Sean Warren and Michael Goelzer, CC BY 4.0: time series, a z-stack and a tile scan. They have no masks, so they go through the Format Converter.
records.translation:
Leica LIF (opinber sýni), nefnt eins og A01/FRAP.lif. Nafngift: auto. Fyllir Format Converter: aðeins myndir, síðan forskoðun.

Ekkert opið safn skrifar LIF, svo þetta eru opinberar sýnisskrár eftir Sean Warren og Michael Goelzer, CC BY 4.0: tímaröð, z-stafli og reitaskönnun. Þær hafa engar grímur, svo þær fara gegnum Format Converter.

records.key: Link a regression hit to candidate objects and quantitative well-level evidence. This does not independently validate the hit.
records.source: Link a regression hit to candidate objects and quantitative well-level evidence. This does not independently validate the hit.
records.translation: Tengdu marktæka niðurstöðu úr aðhvarfi við kandídatahluti og megindleg gögn á brunnstigi. Þetta staðfestir ekki niðurstöðuna á óháðan hátt.

records.key: List a model file you already have, and optionally share it on Hugging Face so others can use it.
records.source: List a model file you already have, and optionally share it on Hugging Face so others can use it.
records.translation: Skráðu líkansskrá sem þú átt þegar, og deildu henni valfrjálst á Hugging Face svo aðrir geti notað hana.

records.key: Liver-stage growth is planned to measure parasite number and size within hepatocytes. Sporozoite motility will focus on gliding trajectories or trails, while Cell traversal will address host-cell wounding along parasite paths. Traversal, productive invasion and subsequent growth are different outcomes: their image markers, observation times and denominators need to be defined separately.
records.source: Liver-stage growth is planned to measure parasite number and size within hepatocytes. Sporozoite motility will focus on gliding trajectories or trails, while Cell traversal will address host-cell wounding along parasite paths. Traversal, productive invasion and subsequent growth are different outcomes: their image markers, observation times and denominators need to be defined separately.
records.translation: Fyrirhugað er að vöxtur á lifrarstigi mæli fjölda og stærð sníkjudýra innan lifrarfrumna. Hreyfanleiki gródýra mun beinast að svifferlum eða slóðum, en Frumugegnumferð mun fjalla um áverka á hýsilfrumum eftir ferlum sníkjudýra. Gegnumferð, árangursrík innrás og síðari vöxtur eru ólíkar útkomur: skilgreina þarf myndmerki þeirra, athugunartíma og nefnara hvert fyrir sig.

records.key: Load a measured project, then Run preview.
records.source: Load a measured project, then Run preview.
records.translation: Hladdu mældu verkefni og ýttu svo á Keyra forskoðun.

records.key: Load the selected Cellpose 3 restoration weights on the GPU. First use may download weights. The captured package version, checkpoint hash and diameter are recorded with applied enhancement.
records.source: Load the selected Cellpose 3 restoration weights on the GPU. First use may download weights. The captured package version, checkpoint hash and diameter are recorded with applied enhancement.
records.translation: Hlaða völdum Cellpose 3 endurheimtarvogum á GPU. Við fyrstu notkun gætu vogir verið sóttar. Skráð pakkaútgáfa, hash vistunarpunkts og þvermál eru skráð með beittri myndbætingu.

records.key: Locate projects and inspect their stage, last run, disk use and stale outputs.
records.source: Locate projects and inspect their stage, last run, disk use and stale outputs.
records.translation: Finndu verkefni og skoðaðu stig þeirra, síðustu keyrslu, diskanotkun og úrelt úttök.

records.key: Look up feature definitions and units before choosing measurement columns.
records.source: Look up feature definitions and units before choosing measurement columns.
records.translation: Flettu upp skilgreiningum og einingum eiginleika áður en mælingadálkar eru valdir.

records.key: Magnifier: segmenting this region — its objects are added as soon as the box is up to date.
records.source: Magnifier: segmenting this region — its objects are added as soon as the box is up to date.
records.translation: Stækkunargler: hluta þetta svæði — hlutum þess er bætt við um leið og kassinn er uppfærður.

records.key: Magnifier: {mode} could not run ({reason}); the Otsu mode is segmenting instead.
records.source: Magnifier: {mode} could not run ({reason}); the Otsu mode is segmenting instead.
records.translation: Stækkunargler: {mode} gat ekki keyrt ({reason}); Otsu-hamurinn hlutar í staðinn.

records.key: Map Barcodes run folder: unique_combinations.csv and annotated_reads.h5. Well identity requires the corresponding barcode references.
records.source: Map Barcodes run folder: unique_combinations.csv and annotated_reads.h5. Well identity requires the corresponding barcode references.
records.translation: Keyrslumappa Map Barcodes: unique_combinations.csv og annotated_reads.h5. Auðkenni brunns krefst samsvarandi strikamerkjaviðmiða.

records.key: Match plate and well identifiers across phenotype and guide-count inputs, select the response and controls, and inspect diagnostics before interpreting hits. Direct measured responses are also supported.
records.source: Match plate and well identifiers across phenotype and guide-count inputs, select the response and controls, and inspect diagnostics before interpreting hits. Direct measured responses are also supported.
records.translation: Paraðu auðkenni platna og brunna milli svipgerðar- og leiðaratalningarinntaka, veldu svörun og viðmið og skoðaðu greiningar áður en marktækar niðurstöður eru túlkaðar. Beinar mældar svaranir eru einnig studdar.

records.key: Mean detected box width and height; verify that the box contains the complete well.
records.source: Mean detected box width and height; verify that the box contains the complete well.
records.translation: Meðalbreidd og -hæð greindra kassa; staðfestu að kassinn innihaldi allan brunninn.

records.key: Measure reads images and label planes together. Enable crop saving if you need PNG files; keep the database and source project together for streamed crops.
records.source: Measure reads images and label planes together. Enable crop saving if you need PNG files; keep the database and source project together for streamed crops.
records.translation: Mæling les myndir og merkjaplön saman. Virkjaðu vistun myndskurða ef þú þarft PNG-skrár; haltu gagnagrunninum og upprunaverkefninu saman fyrir streymda myndskurði.

records.key: Merged mask plane: Auto uses recorded plane metadata; -1 hides this mask. Choose a plane explicitly for older projects.
records.source: Merged mask plane: Auto uses recorded plane metadata; -1 hides this mask. Choose a plane explicitly for older projects.
records.translation: Sameinað grímuplan: Sjálfvirkt notar skráð lýsigögn plana; -1 felur þessa grímu. Veldu plan skýrt fyrir eldri verkefni.

records.key: Montage loading cancelled; the current disk operation may finish.
records.source: Montage loading cancelled; the current disk operation may finish.
records.translation: Hætt við hleðslu myndasamstæðu; núverandi diskaðgerð gæti lokið.

records.key: Name this template — something you would say out loud, like “Toxo PVM, 40×”:
records.source: Name this template — something you would say out loud, like “Toxo PVM, 40×”:
records.translation: Nefndu þetta sniðmát — eitthvað sem þú myndir segja upphátt, eins og „Toxo PVM, 40×“:

records.key:
Nikon ND2 (public sample), named like A01/WellA01_ChannelBF_Seq0001.nd2. Naming: auto. Fills the Format Converter: images only, then previews.

No open library writes ND2, so this is a public sample file by Maxime Woringer, CC BY 4.0: one brightfield plane, renamed the way NIS-Elements JOBS names a well-plate acquisition. It has no masks, so it goes through the Format Converter.
records.source:
Nikon ND2 (public sample), named like A01/WellA01_ChannelBF_Seq0001.nd2. Naming: auto. Fills the Format Converter: images only, then previews.

No open library writes ND2, so this is a public sample file by Maxime Woringer, CC BY 4.0: one brightfield plane, renamed the way NIS-Elements JOBS names a well-plate acquisition. It has no masks, so it goes through the Format Converter.
records.translation:
Nikon ND2 (opinbert sýni), nefnt eins og A01/WellA01_ChannelBF_Seq0001.nd2. Nafngift: auto. Fyllir Format Converter: aðeins myndir, síðan forskoðun.

Ekkert opið safn skrifar ND2, svo þetta er opinber sýnisskrá eftir Maxime Woringer, CC BY 4.0: eitt bjartsviðsplan, endurnefnt eins og NIS-Elements JOBS nefnir myndatöku á brunnaplötu. Hún hefur engar grímur, svo hún fer gegnum Format Converter.

records.key:
No Hugging Face token was found, so nothing was uploaded.

Run `huggingface-cli login`, or set HF_TOKEN, and press Add again. spaCR does not ship a token of its own: one that could upload could also delete, and it would be readable by anyone who installs spaCR.
records.source:
No Hugging Face token was found, so nothing was uploaded.

Run `huggingface-cli login`, or set HF_TOKEN, and press Add again. spaCR does not ship a token of its own: one that could upload could also delete, and it would be readable by anyone who installs spaCR.
records.translation:
Enginn Hugging Face-lykill fannst, svo engu var hlaðið upp.

Keyrðu `huggingface-cli login`, eða stilltu HF_TOKEN, og ýttu aftur á Bæta við. spaCR fylgir ekki eigin lykill: lykill sem gæti hlaðið upp gæti líka eytt, og allir sem setja upp spaCR gætu lesið hann.

records.key: No cell probability map: {objects} came from a method that does not make one. Only Cellpose does.
records.source: No cell probability map: {objects} came from a method that does not make one. Only Cellpose does.
records.translation: Ekkert frumulíkindakort: {objects} komu úr aðferð sem býr ekki til slíkt. Aðeins Cellpose gerir það.

records.key: No templates yet for this module. Set the settings up the way you want them, then use “Save current settings…”.
records.source: No templates yet for this module. Set the settings up the way you want them, then use “Save current settings…”.
records.translation: Engin sniðmát enn fyrir þessa einingu. Stilltu stillingarnar eins og þú vilt hafa þær og notaðu svo „Vista núverandi stillingar…“.

records.key: No two centres closer together than this, so one object cannot become two. About one object radius. Raise it when objects are being split, lower it when two touching objects come back as one.
records.source: No two centres closer together than this, so one object cannot become two. About one object radius. Raise it when objects are being split, lower it when two touching objects come back as one.
records.translation: Engar tvær miðjur nær hvor annarri en þetta, svo einn hlutur geti ekki orðið tveir. Um einn radíus hlutar. Hækkaðu það þegar hlutir klofna, lækkaðu það þegar tveir snertandi hlutir koma út sem einn.

records.key: Nothing to save: run the preview on a figure first.
records.source: Nothing to save: run the preview on a figure first.
records.translation: Ekkert að vista: keyrðu fyrst forskoðun á mynd.

records.key:
OME-TIFF, one plane per file, named like slide--S00/chamber--U00--V04/field--X08--Y00/image--L00--S00--U00--V04--J20--E00--O00--X08--Y00--T00--Z00--C00.ome.tif. Naming: leica_matrix_screener. Fills the Import screen: images, cell / nucleus / pathogen masks and a measurements table, then previews.

The Matrix Screener names a field by its X/Y position, not a number, so fields are numbered in order.
records.source:
OME-TIFF, one plane per file, named like slide--S00/chamber--U00--V04/field--X08--Y00/image--L00--S00--U00--V04--J20--E00--O00--X08--Y00--T00--Z00--C00.ome.tif. Naming: leica_matrix_screener. Fills the Import screen: images, cell / nucleus / pathogen masks and a measurements table, then previews.

The Matrix Screener names a field by its X/Y position, not a number, so fields are numbered in order.
records.translation:
OME-TIFF, eitt plan í hverri skrá, nefnt eins og slide--S00/chamber--U00--V04/field--X08--Y00/image--L00--S00--U00--V04--J20--E00--O00--X08--Y00--T00--Z00--C00.ome.tif. Nafngift: leica_matrix_screener. Fyllir skjáinn Flytja inn: myndir, grímur frumna / kjarna / sýkla og mælingatafla, síðan forskoðun.

Matrix Screener nefnir sjónsvið eftir X/Y-staðsetningu þess, ekki númeri, svo sjónsvið eru númeruð í röð.

records.key:
OME-TIFF, three channels per file, named like E01/field009.ome.tif. Naming: auto. Fills the Import screen: images, cell / nucleus / pathogen masks and a measurements table, then previews.

Channels are read from inside the file.
records.source:
OME-TIFF, three channels per file, named like E01/field009.ome.tif. Naming: auto. Fills the Import screen: images, cell / nucleus / pathogen masks and a measurements table, then previews.

Channels are read from inside the file.
records.translation:
OME-TIFF, þrjár rásir í hverri skrá, nefnt eins og E01/field009.ome.tif. Nafngift: auto. Fyllir skjáinn Flytja inn: myndir, grímur frumna / kjarna / sýkla og mælingatafla, síðan forskoðun.

Rásir eru lesnar innan úr skránni.

records.key: OPS destination measurements.db: per-well geometry, phenotype alignment, nuclei and barcode tables; optional per-cycle reads.
records.source: OPS destination measurements.db: per-well geometry, phenotype alignment, nuclei and barcode tables; optional per-cycle reads.
records.translation: measurements.db á áfangastað OPS: töflur um rúmfræði hvers brunns, jöfnun svipgerðar, kjarna og strikamerki; valfrjálsir lestrar fyrir hverja umferð.

records.key: Object detection found no objects — the mask is unchanged. The Cell probability tab shows what it had to work with.
records.source: Object detection found no objects — the mask is unchanged. The Cell probability tab shows what it had to work with.
records.translation: Hlutagreining fann enga hluti — gríman er óbreytt. Flipinn Frumulíkindi sýnir hvað hún hafði úr að moða.

records.key: Object-indexed encoder features, with channel policy and encoder provenance. The encoding API returns features; persistence is caller-dependent.
records.source: Object-indexed encoder features, with channel policy and encoder provenance. The encoding API returns features; persistence is caller-dependent.
records.translation: Kóðaraeiginleikar raðaðir eftir hlut, með rásareglu og uppruna kóðara. Kóðunar-API skilar eiginleikum; vistun fer eftir kallanda.

records.key: Objects under the Min area in Object operations are dropped after the threshold.
records.source: Objects under the Min area in Object operations are dropped after the threshold.
records.translation: Hlutum undir Lágm. flatarmáli í Hlutaaðgerðum er fleygt eftir þröskuldun.

records.key: Off by default, so the volume stays wherever a spin leaves it. On, every spin ends square-on to the nearest face.
records.source: Off by default, so the volume stays wherever a spin leaves it. On, every spin ends square-on to the nearest face.
records.translation: Slökkt sjálfgefið, svo rúmmálið helst þar sem snúningur skilur við það. Ef kveikt er endar hver snúningur beint á næsta flöt.

records.key: Off by default. While it is off spaCR loads no audio library and plays nothing at all. On, spaCR plays the sounds switched on below through your computer's default audio output.
records.source: Off by default. While it is off spaCR loads no audio library and plays nothing at all. On, spaCR plays the sounds switched on below through your computer's default audio output.
records.translation: Slökkt sjálfgefið. Meðan slökkt er hleður spaCR engu hljóðsafni og spilar ekkert. Ef kveikt er spilar spaCR hljóðin sem kveikt er á hér fyrir neðan gegnum sjálfgefið hljóðúttak tölvunnar.

records.key: Offers to install the GitHub CLI and then signs you in. Without it, filing an issue still works -- it opens in whichever browser you are already signed in to.
records.source: Offers to install the GitHub CLI and then signs you in. Without it, filing an issue still works -- it opens in whichever browser you are already signed in to.
records.translation: Býðst til að setja upp GitHub CLI og skráir þig svo inn. Án þess virkar samt að skrá mál -- það opnast í þeim vafra sem þú ert þegar innskráð/ur í.

records.key: On by default. A build's bundled release notes stop at the release before its own, so with this on spaCR reads the public list of releases from GitHub once a day, on a background thread, after Home is drawn, and shows anything newer at the top of News. Nothing is sent and nothing is signed in. Off shows only the notes bundled in this build.
records.source: On by default. A build's bundled release notes stop at the release before its own, so with this on spaCR reads the public list of releases from GitHub once a day, on a background thread, after Home is drawn, and shows anything newer at the top of News. Nothing is sent and nothing is signed in. Off shows only the notes bundled in this build.
records.translation: Virkt sjálfgefið. Útgáfuskýringar sem fylgja útgáfu enda á útgáfunni á undan henni, svo þegar þetta er virkt les spaCR opinbera útgáfulistann frá GitHub einu sinni á dag, á bakgrunnsþræði, eftir að Heimaskjárinn er teiknaður, og sýnir allt nýrra efst í Fréttum. Ekkert er sent og engin innskráning fer fram. Óvirkt sýnir aðeins skýringarnar sem fylgja þessari útgáfu.

records.key: On by default. When on, an error report saves recent log lines, with paths and credentials redacted, to a file on this computer and names that file in the report. The log itself is never posted to GitHub.
records.source: On by default. When on, an error report saves recent log lines, with paths and credentials redacted, to a file on this computer and names that file in the report. The log itself is never posted to GitHub.
records.translation: Virkt sjálfgefið. Þegar þetta er virkt vistar villuskýrsla nýlegar annálalínur, með slóðum og aðgangsupplýsingum fjarlægðum, í skrá á þessari tölvu og nefnir þá skrá í skýrslunni. Annállinn sjálfur er aldrei birtur á GitHub.

records.key: On the CPU a whole field takes tens of seconds and the magnifier box about a second.
records.source: On the CPU a whole field takes tens of seconds and the magnifier box about a second.
records.translation: Á CPU tekur heilt sjónsvið tugi sekúndna og stækkunarglerskassinn um sekúndu.

records.key: On: the number above is a percentile of this image. Off: it is an absolute intensity, which is what to use when the same setting must mean the same thing across fields of different exposure.
records.source: On: the number above is a percentile of this image. Off: it is an absolute intensity, which is what to use when the same setting must mean the same thing across fields of different exposure.
records.translation: Kveikt: talan hér að ofan er hundraðsmark þessarar myndar. Slökkt: hún er algildur styrkur, sem á að nota þegar sama stilling þarf að merkja það sama milli sjónsviða með ólíkan lýsingartíma.

records.key: One plate, or all of them. A scale is estimated per run, so a run over two plates scales both by one number.
records.source: One plate, or all of them. A scale is estimated per run, so a run over two plates scales both by one number.
records.translation: Ein plata, eða allar. Kvarði er metinn fyrir hverja keyrslu, svo keyrsla yfir tvær plötur kvarðar báðar með einni tölu.

records.key: Only pieces holding a pixel above this survive at all, and they then grow outward down to the weak level. Read as a percentile below 1.0, as an absolute intensity above it.
records.source: Only pieces holding a pixel above this survive at all, and they then grow outward down to the weak level. Read as a percentile below 1.0, as an absolute intensity above it.
records.translation: Aðeins bútar sem innihalda pixil yfir þessu lifa af, og þeir vaxa síðan út á við niður að veika stiginu. Lesið sem hundraðsmark undir 1.0, sem algildur styrkur yfir því.

records.key: Open Cellpose Workbench inside Make Masks and train from verified image/mask pairs. Evaluate on separate fields before selecting the checkpoint in Mask.
records.source: Open Cellpose Workbench inside Make Masks and train from verified image/mask pairs. Evaluate on separate fields before selecting the checkpoint in Mask.

records.source: Open Timelapse within Mask to segment and link objects across ordered frames; inspect links before downstream motility analysis.
records.translation: Opnaðu Tímaraðir innan Grímur til að hluta og tengja hluti yfir raðaða ramma; skoðaðu tengingar fyrir áframhaldandi hreyfanleikagreiningu.

records.key: Open a crop project in Annotate. Load test data provides an example. Choose the annotation column and label representative objects.
records.source: Open a crop project in Annotate. Load test data provides an example. Choose the annotation column and label representative objects.
records.translation: Opnaðu myndskurðaverkefni í Merkingu. Hlaða prófunargögnum gefur dæmi. Veldu merkingadálkinn og merktu dæmigerða hluti.

records.key: Open a folder before running Object detection.

records.translation: Opnaðu möppu áður en Hlutagreining er keyrð.

records.key: Open a module with a settings panel first — a template is a bundle of one module's settings.
records.source: Open a module with a settings panel first — a template is a bundle of one module's settings.
records.translation: Opnaðu fyrst einingu með stillingaspjaldi — sniðmát er safn stillinga einnar einingar.

records.key: Open a saved regression result and inspect effect sizes, adjusted significance and individual hit records.
records.source: Open a saved regression result and inspect effect sizes, adjusted significance and individual hit records.
records.translation: Opnaðu vistaða aðhvarfsniðurstöðu og skoðaðu áhrifastærðir, leiðrétta marktækni og einstakar færslur marktækra niðurstaðna.

records.key: Open the diagnostics actually written by this run.
records.source: Open the diagnostics actually written by this run.
records.translation: Opnaðu greiningargögnin sem þessi keyrsla skrifaði í raun.

records.key:
Planes displayed in the montage. Enter the colour letters used by Annotate — r, g, b, or a combination such as 'r,g,b', 'rg', or 'b' — and each letter is resolved to the corresponding source channel. Source-channel indices such as '0,1,2' are also accepted.

Plön sem birt eru í myndasamstæðunni. Sláðu inn litstafina sem Merking notar — r, g, b, eða samsetningu eins og 'r,g,b', 'rg' eða 'b' — og hverjum staf er varpað á samsvarandi upprunarás. Vísar upprunarása eins og '0,1,2' eru einnig samþykktir.

records.translation: Skelluhamur les útklipptar skellumyndir; Figure-hamur les birtar myndir úr greinum. Stillingarnar hér fyrir neðan og lifandi forskoðunin fylgja þessum rofa.

records.translation: Skelluhamur: mappa með útklipptum skellumyndum. Hver mynd er hlutuð og keyrslan skrifar töflu með gildum fyrir hverja mynd og töflu með gildum fyrir hverja skellu.

records.key: Plasmodium parasites cause malaria. Their life cycle includes mosquito and vertebrate hosts, with liver and blood stages in humans. records.source: Plasmodium parasites cause malaria. Their life cycle includes mosquito and vertebrate hosts, with liver and blood stages in humans. records.translation: Plasmodium-sníkjudýr valda malaríu. Lífsferill þeirra nær til moskítóflugna og hryggdýrahýsla, með lifrar- og blóðstigum í mönnum. Smásjárskoðun greinir á milli forma sníkjudýrsins í sýktum rauðum blóðkornum. Myndbundnar rannsóknir geta mælt tíðni sýkinga, framvindu stiga, hreyfanleika og svörun við efnasamböndum.

records.source: Provide the saved label TIFFs and their original images to External Masks, assign object roles and create the merged project before Measure.
records.translation: Gefðu vistuðu merkja-TIFFs og upprunalegu myndir þeirra upp í External Masks, úthlutaðu hlutverkum hluta og búðu til sameinaða verkefnið fyrir Mælingu.

records.key: Pseudo wells from condition/folder column
records.source: Pseudo wells from condition/folder column
records.translation: Gervibrunnar úr dálki aðstæðna/möppu

records.source: Python settings dictionary: iterable sweep values for screen size, occupancy, classifier accuracy and sequencing assumptions, plus replicates, src, name, variable, plot and max_workers. generate_parameters expands their Cartesian product; begin with a small sweep and an explicit worker bound.
records.translation: Python-stillingaorðabók: ítranleg sveipgildi fyrir stærð skimunar, nýtingu, nákvæmni flokkara og forsendur raðgreiningar, auk endurtekninga, src, name, variable, plot og max_workers. generate_parameters víkkar út kartesíska margfeldi þeirra; byrjaðu með litlu sveipi og skýru hámarki á vinnsluþráðum.

records.source: Rank measured features for a chosen class comparison; review filtering and class definitions before interpreting the ranking.
records.translation: Raðaðu mældum eiginleikum fyrir valinn flokkasamanburð; yfirfarðu síun og skilgreiningar flokka áður en röðunin er túlkuð.

records.source: Re-measure only when needed; External Masks can already perform measurement.
records.translation: Mældu aftur aðeins þegar þörf er á; External Masks getur þegar framkvæmt mælingar.

records.key: Read measured compartment areas, annotate conditions and bin area ** 1.5 into log2 size doublings. Defaults aggregate pathogen area per host cell, not per vacuole: multiple vacuoles in one cell are combined. This is an area-derived size proxy, not measured volume or a parasite count. Use Replication Assay with explicit vacuole identity for parasites-per-vacuole counts. Configure compartment, area filters, calibration, conditions and grouping before calling the API; saving is optional.
records.source: Read measured compartment areas, annotate conditions and bin area ** 1.5 into log2 size doublings. Defaults aggregate pathogen area per host cell, not per vacuole: multiple vacuoles in one cell are combined. This is an area-derived size proxy, not measured volume or a parasite count. Use Replication Assay with explicit vacuole identity for parasites-per-vacuole counts. Configure compartment, area filters, calibration, conditions and grouping before calling the API; saving is optional.
records.translation: Lesa mæld flatarmál hólfa, merkja aðstæður og flokka flatarmál ** 1.5 í log2-stærðartvöfaldanir. Sjálfgefið er flatarmál sýkla tekið saman fyrir hverja hýsilfrumu, ekki hverja safabólu: margar safabólur í einni frumu eru sameinaðar. Þetta er flatarmálsbundin stærðarnálgun, ekki mælt rúmmál eða talning sníkjudýra. Notaðu Replication Assay með skýru auðkenni safabóla fyrir talningu sníkjudýra í hverri safabólu. Stilltu hólf, flatarmálssíur, kvörðun, aðstæður og flokkun áður en kallað er á API; vistun er valfrjáls.

records.translation: Fjarlægja alla hluti úr þessu sjónsviði. Spurt er fyrst og þetta er eitt afturköllunarskref, svo óvart ýtt kostar eitt Ctrl+Z.

records.key: Replication Assay counts parasites per vacuole, providing a readout of intracellular growth at the sampled time. Plaque Assay measures cleared areas across a host-cell monolayer and therefore integrates multiple rounds of infection and growth. A smaller plaque can reflect more than one defect: compare the plaque result with invasion and replication measurements before assigning it to a particular step.
records.source: Replication Assay counts parasites per vacuole, providing a readout of intracellular growth at the sampled time. Plaque Assay measures cleared areas across a host-cell monolayer and therefore integrates multiple rounds of infection and growth. A smaller plaque can reflect more than one defect: compare the plaque result with invasion and replication measurements before assigning it to a particular step.
records.translation: Replication Assay telur sníkjudýr í hverri safabólu og gefur mælingu á vexti innan frumna á sýnatökutímanum. Plaque Assay mælir hreinsuð svæði yfir einlag hýsilfrumna og nær því yfir margar umferðir sýkingar og vaxtar. Minni skella getur endurspeglað fleiri en einn galla: berðu skelluniðurstöðuna saman við mælingar á innrás og fjölgun áður en henni er eignað tiltekið skref.

records.source: Require explicit parasite-to-vacuole identities.
records.translation: Krefstu skýrra auðkenna sníkjudýra gagnvart safabólum.

records.key: Require the intended compartment intensities and identities.

records.translation: Ef bendillinn hvílir á hnappi, reit eða dálkfyrirsögn í tvær sekúndur birtist lítill merkimiði sem segir hvað það er. Merkimiðinn helst meðan bendillinn er á honum og hverfur sekúndu eftir að bendillinn fer. Ef hakið er tekið af birtast engar skjábendingar neins staðar í spaCR.

records.translation: Varðveittu uppruna kóðara og rásareglna.

records.key: Run a stock or custom Cellpose model on TIFF fields through the Python API. Despite its historical identify_masks_finetune name, this function performs inference, not training. Review normalization, channels, resizing and model parameters; masks are written only when save is enabled. Import compatible image/mask pairs through External Masks before Measure, or curate the pairs before training. This call does not build a Measure-ready merged project.
records.source: Run a stock or custom Cellpose model on TIFF fields through the Python API. Despite its historical identify_masks_finetune name, this function performs inference, not training. Review normalization, channels, resizing and model parameters; masks are written only when save is enabled. Import compatible image/mask pairs through External Masks before Measure, or curate the pairs before training. This call does not build a Measure-ready merged project.
records.translation: Keyra staðlað eða sérsniðið Cellpose-líkan á TIFF-sjónsvið gegnum Python API. Þrátt fyrir sögulega heitið identify_masks_finetune framkvæmir þetta fall ályktun, ekki þjálfun. Yfirfarðu stöðlun, rásir, stærðarbreytingu og líkanstika; grímur eru aðeins skrifaðar þegar vistun er virk. Fluttu samrýmanleg pör mynda og gríma inn gegnum External Masks fyrir Mælingu, eða veldu pörin fyrir þjálfun. Þetta kall býr ekki til sameinað verkefni tilbúið fyrir Mælingu.

records.translation: Keyra CPU-aðferðina sem valin er undir Greiningaraðferð á alla myndina og merkja það sem hún finnur, með tilliti til lágmarksflatarmálsins hér að ofan. Allt sem aðferðin les er í þeim flokki: reiknirit stigsins, leiðréttingin, mýkingin, hvor hliðin er hluturinn, fylling gata, skipting pars sem snertist og brottfelling þess sem ramminn skar. Ef Cellpose eða bakendi er valinn fellur þessi hnappur aftur á Otsu, því þeir hafa eigin hnapp fyrir Hlutagreiningu.

records.key: Run the chosen pipeline across plates. Outputs are those of each queued module; retain each plate and its settings separately.
records.source: Run the chosen pipeline across plates. Outputs are those of each queued module; retain each plate and its settings separately.
records.translation: Keyrðu valda vinnsluferlið yfir plötur. Úttökin eru úttök hverrar einingar í biðröðinni; haltu hverri plötu og stillingum hennar aðskildum.

records.key: Save or stream crops with stable object identities.

records.translation: Vistaðu eða streymdu myndskurðum með stöðugum auðkennum hluta.

records.translation: Vista myndina eins og hún er teiknuð hér, í fullri stærð: útlínur og brunnarammar halda línuþykkt og litum sem valdir voru fyrir þau.

records.key: Saved Cellpose-compatible checkpoint or a compatible installed backend selected with its own configuration.
records.source: Saved Cellpose-compatible checkpoint or a compatible installed backend selected with its own configuration.

records.key: Saved model-response/saliency images for the matching classifier and input preprocessing.
records.source: Saved model-response/saliency images for the matching classifier and input preprocessing.
records.translation: Vistaðar svörunar-/áberandi myndir líkans fyrir samsvarandi flokkara og forvinnslu inntaks.

records.key: Saved module/plate/settings job definitions and dependency order.
records.source: Saved module/plate/settings job definitions and dependency order.
records.translation: Vistaðar skilgreiningar verka fyrir einingu/plötu/stillingar og röð ákvæða.

records.key: Saved planning tables or figures based on explicitly chosen effect sizes, variability and sampling assumptions.
records.source: Saved planning tables or figures based on explicitly chosen effect sizes, variability and sampling assumptions.
records.translation: Vistaðar áætlunartöflur eða myndir byggðar á skýrt völdum áhrifastærðum, breytileika og forsendum úrtaks.

records.key: Saved score CSVs and, when merged, measurements/measurements.db, table png_list.
records.source: Saved score CSVs and, when merged, measurements/measurements.db, table png_list.
records.translation: Vistaðar skor-CSVs og, þegar sameinað er, measurements/measurements.db, taflan png_list.

records.key: Saved threshold/polygon gate definitions or a selected object set; apply a gate to the same feature definitions.
records.source: Saved threshold/polygon gate definitions or a selected object set; apply a gate to the same feature definitions.
records.translation: Vistaðar skilgreiningar þröskulda-/marghyrningsvalsvæða eða valið hlutamengi; beittu valsvæði á sömu skilgreiningar eiginleika.

records.source: Scale this preview's controls, text and pictures, from 10 % to 200 %, without changing the rest of spaCR. It applies straight away and is remembered for this preview. Double-click the percentage to go back to 100 %; Ctrl+Alt+0 resets every scale.
records.translation: Kvarða stýringar, texta og myndir þessarar forskoðunar, frá 10 % til 200 %, án þess að breyta restinni af spaCR. Það tekur gildi strax og er munað fyrir þessa forskoðun. Tvísmelltu á prósentuna til að fara aftur í 100 %; Ctrl+Alt+0 endurstillir alla kvarða.

records.key: Scroll to zoom, drag to pan. Both pictures move together.
records.source: Scroll to zoom, drag to pan. Both pictures move together.
records.translation: Skrunaðu til að þysja, dragðu til að hliðra. Báðar myndirnar hreyfast saman.

records.key: Select CV predictions and the matching measured objects.
records.source: Select CV predictions and the matching measured objects.
records.translation: Veldu CV-spár og samsvarandi mælda hluti.

records.key: Select a project with merged images and masks. Load test data provides an example. Check the image and label channels before measuring.
records.source: Select a project with merged images and masks. Load test data provides an example. Check the image and label channels before measuring.
records.translation: Veldu verkefni með sameinuðum myndum og grímum. Hlaða prófunargögnum gefur dæmi. Athugaðu mynd- og merkjarásir áður en mælt er.

records.key: Select channels and models, inspect a preview, then run Mask. Measure consumes the merged arrays; the counts database is not yet a feature table.
records.source: Select channels and models, inspect a preview, then run Mask. Measure consumes the merged arrays; the counts database is not yet a feature table.
records.translation: Veldu rásir og líkön, skoðaðu forskoðun og keyrðu svo Grímur. Mæling notar sameinuðu fylkin; talningagagnagrunnurinn er ekki enn eiginleikatafla.

records.key: Select the intended CV or ML score column and preserve plate/well identity.
records.source: Select the intended CV or ML score column and preserve plate/well identity.
records.translation: Veldu tilætlaðan CV- eða ML-skordálk og varðveittu auðkenni plötu/brunns.

records.key: Select the saved compatible checkpoint in Mask.
records.source: Select the saved compatible checkpoint in Mask.
records.translation: Veldu vistaða samrýmanlega vistunarpunktinn í Grímur.

records.key: Select your FASTQ files and matching barcode references. Load test data provides an example. Check the column, row and guide references before mapping.
records.source: Select your FASTQ files and matching barcode references. Load test data provides an example. Check the column, row and guide references before mapping.
records.translation: Veldu FASTQ-skrárnar þínar og samsvarandi strikamerkjaviðmið. Hlaða prófunargögnum gefur dæmi. Athugaðu viðmið dálka, raða og leiðara áður en varpað er.

records.key: Selected run results folder: coefficient/result CSVs, hit tables, settings and diagnostic figures.
records.source: Selected run results folder: coefficient/result CSVs, hit tables, settings and diagnostic figures.
records.translation: Valin mappa keyrsluniðurstaðna: CSVs með stuðlum/niðurstöðum, töflur marktækra niðurstaðna, stillingar og greiningarmyndir.

records.key: Send the matching image/labels to napari and import the revised labels back with field identity preserved.
records.source: Send the matching image/labels to napari and import the revised labels back with field identity preserved.
records.translation: Sendu samsvarandi mynd/merki í napari og fluttu endurskoðuðu merkin aftur inn með auðkenni sjónsviðs varðveitt.

records.key: Separate image and integer-mask files with matching field identities; preserve original images and labels.
records.source: Separate image and integer-mask files with matching field identities; preserve original images and labels.
records.translation: Aðskildar skrár mynda og heiltölugríma með samsvarandi auðkennum sjónsviða; varðveittu upprunalegar myndir og merki.

records.translation:
Deila þessu líkani svo aðrir notendur spaCR geti sótt það?

Þú verður beðin/n um tölurnar sem fara í matsspjald þess. Því er hlaðið upp í sameiginlega spaCR-safnið, þar sem það bíður yfirferðar áður en það birtist í Líkanasafninu -- þú þarft ekki Hugging Face-aðgang.

records.key: Show newer releases than this build in Home's News panel
records.source: Show newer releases than this build in Home's News panel
records.translation: Sýna nýrri útgáfur en þessa útgáfu í Fréttum á Heimaskjánum

records.key: Showing the enhanced image the detector reads.
records.source: Showing the enhanced image the detector reads.
records.translation: Sýni bættu myndina sem skynjarinn les.

records.key: Showing the first 50 measured fields; choose a narrower source for other fields.
records.source: Showing the first 50 measured fields; choose a narrower source for other fields.
records.translation: Sýni fyrstu 50 mældu sjónsviðin; veldu þrengri uppruna fyrir önnur sjónsvið.

records.key: Showing the image inverted — dark is bright — and detecting on it. The hover intensity follows the picture and says so; filtering, the object mean and saving still use the original pixels.
records.source: Showing the image inverted — dark is bright — and detecting on it. The hover intensity follows the picture and says so; filtering, the object mean and saving still use the original pixels.
records.translation: Sýni myndina umsnúna — dökkt er bjart — og greini á henni. Styrkurinn við bendilinn fylgir myndinni og segir það; síun, meðaltal hlutar og vistun nota enn upprunalegu pixlana.

records.key: Sign in to {label} in the window that opened. spaCR notices when you are done.
records.source: Sign in to {label} in the window that opened. spaCR notices when you are done.
records.translation: Skráðu þig inn í {label} í glugganum sem opnaðist. spaCR tekur eftir því þegar þú ert búin/n.

records.key: Signing in to {label} did not finish within {minutes} minutes. Press Sign in to try again.
records.source: Signing in to {label} did not finish within {minutes} minutes. Press Sign in to try again.
records.translation: Innskráning í {label} lauk ekki innan {minutes} mínútna. Ýttu á Skrá inn til að reyna aftur.

records.key: Single-end or paired FASTQ files, with the matching barcode reference tables.
records.source: Single-end or paired FASTQ files, with the matching barcode reference tables.
records.translation: FASTQ-skrár, einhliða eða paraðar, ásamt samsvarandi viðmiðunartöflum strikamerkja.

records.key: Smooth the noise before the contrast step amplifies it. Gaussian is a blur and softens edges with the noise; Median removes speckle and keeps edges; Bilateral and Non-local means keep edges better still and are much slower. HEAVY: non-local means is minutes on a whole 2,000 px field, and seconds on a magnifier box.
records.source: Smooth the noise before the contrast step amplifies it. Gaussian is a blur and softens edges with the noise; Median removes speckle and keeps edges; Bilateral and Non-local means keep edges better still and are much slower. HEAVY: non-local means is minutes on a whole 2,000 px field, and seconds on a magnifier box.
records.translation: Mýkja suðið áður en birtuskerpuskrefið magnar það. Gaussískt er þoka og mýkir brúnir ásamt suðinu; Miðgildi fjarlægir flekki og heldur brúnum; Tvíhliða sía og Ekki-staðbundin meðaltöl halda brúnum enn betur og eru mun hægari. ÞUNGT: ekki-staðbundin meðaltöl taka mínútur á heilu 2,000 px sjónsviði og sekúndur á stækkunarglerskassa.

records.key: Sort every file this table already holds again, with the regex as it reads now.
records.source: Sort every file this table already holds again, with the regex as it reads now.
records.translation: Flokka aftur allar skrár sem þessi tafla geymir nú þegar, með reglulegu segðinni eins og hún er núna.

records.key: Source image folder; original files, supported vendor files or imported TIFFs.
records.source: Source image folder; original files, supported vendor files or imported TIFFs.
records.translation: Mappa upprunamynda; upprunalegar skrár, studdar framleiðandaskrár eða innfluttar TIFFs.

records.key: Spin about {axis} only: a drag turns the volume about that measurement's axis and leaves it where it is on screen.
records.source: Spin about {axis} only: a drag turns the volume about that measurement's axis and leaves it where it is on screen.
records.translation: Snúa aðeins um {axis}: dráttur snýr rúmmálinu um ás þeirrar mælingar og skilur það eftir á sama stað á skjánum.

records.key: Starplast {installed} is installed. Version {latest} is available on PyPI. Upgrade through pip before opening?
records.source: Starplast {installed} is installed. Version {latest} is available on PyPI. Upgrade through pip before opening?
records.translation: Starplast {installed} er uppsett. Útgáfa {latest} er í boði á PyPI. Uppfæra með pip áður en opnað er?

records.key: Start with an image project. Use Load test data within Mask for an example, or select your image folder. Check the channel assignments before running.
records.source: Start with an image project. Use Load test data within Mask for an example, or select your image folder. Check the channel assignments before running.
records.translation: Byrjaðu á myndaverkefni. Notaðu Hlaða prófunargögnum í Grímur fyrir dæmi, eða veldu myndamöppuna þína. Athugaðu úthlutun rása áður en keyrt er.

records.key: Stop this montage and queued selections after the current read finishes.
records.source: Stop this montage and queued selections after the current read finishes.
records.translation: Stöðva þessa myndasamstæðu og val í biðröð eftir að núverandi lestri lýkur.

records.key: Stopped waiting for the sign-in. Press Sign in to start it again, or Done once you have signed in.
records.source: Stopped waiting for the sign-in. Press Sign in to start it again, or Done once you have signed in.
records.translation: Hætti að bíða eftir innskráningunni. Ýttu á Skrá inn til að hefja hana aftur, eða á Lokið þegar þú hefur skráð þig inn.

records.key: Stored project checks and QC reports; a missing check is not a passing result.
records.source: Stored project checks and QC reports; a missing check is not a passing result.
records.translation: Vistaðar athuganir verkefnis og QC-skýrslur; athugun sem vantar er ekki staðin niðurstaða.

records.key: Submit a configured run to a remote execution target and inspect its status and logs. Retrieve the actual module artifacts before downstream analysis.
records.source: Submit a configured run to a remote execution target and inspect its status and logs. Retrieve the actual module artifacts before downstream analysis.
records.translation: Sendu stillta keyrslu á fjartengt keyrslumark og skoðaðu stöðu hennar og annála. Sæktu raunverulegar afurðir einingarinnar fyrir áframhaldandi greiningu.

records.key: Subtract the slowly varying background before anything else. Rolling ball fits a surface of the radius below and takes it away, which is what flattens uneven illumination; Top-hat keeps only what is brighter than its surroundings within that radius and is much faster. Set the radius comfortably LARGER than the largest object: a radius under the object size eats the objects with the background. The background is ESTIMATED on a smaller copy, at the scale below, because a background is by definition what varies slowly across the field and so is the one thing that survives being looked at smaller.
records.source: Subtract the slowly varying background before anything else. Rolling ball fits a surface of the radius below and takes it away, which is what flattens uneven illumination; Top-hat keeps only what is brighter than its surroundings within that radius and is much faster. Set the radius comfortably LARGER than the largest object: a radius under the object size eats the objects with the background. The background is ESTIMATED on a smaller copy, at the scale below, because a background is by definition what varies slowly across the field and so is the one thing that survives being looked at smaller.
records.translation: Draga hægt breytilegan bakgrunn frá á undan öllu öðru. Rúllandi kúla mátar yfirborð með radíusnum hér fyrir neðan og fjarlægir það, sem jafnar út ójafna lýsingu; Top-hat heldur aðeins því sem er bjartara en umhverfið innan þess radíuss og er mun hraðvirkara. Stilltu radíusinn vel STÆRRI en stærsta hlutinn: radíus undir stærð hlutanna étur hlutina með bakgrunninum. Bakgrunnurinn er METINN á minna afriti, við kvarðann hér fyrir neðan, því bakgrunnur er samkvæmt skilgreiningu það sem breytist hægt yfir sjónsviðið og er því það eina sem þolir að vera skoðað minna.

records.key: Suggested crops wear a ? badge. Click one or press Y to confirm it; right-click or press N to reject it; U undoes.
records.source: Suggested crops wear a ? badge. Click one or press Y to confirm it; right-click or press N to reject it; U undoes.
records.translation: Tillögur að myndskurðum bera ?-merki. Smelltu á einn eða ýttu á Y til að staðfesta hann; hægrismelltu eða ýttu á N til að hafna honum; U afturkallar.

records.key: Suits a field split near half and half. The level is the mean intensity, which is as crude as it sounds and is here as a baseline to judge the others against.
records.source: Suits a field split near half and half. The level is the mean intensity, which is as crude as it sounds and is here as a baseline to judge the others against.
records.translation: Hentar sjónsviði sem skiptist nálægt til helminga. Stigið er meðalstyrkurinn, sem er jafn gróft og það hljómar og er hér sem grunnlína til að meta hin gegn.

records.key: Suits a field whose objects are a small, bright minority -- Li minimises the cross entropy between the field and its thresholded self rather than assuming two equal populations, so it holds up where Otsu drifts into the background.
records.source: Suits a field whose objects are a small, bright minority -- Li minimises the cross entropy between the field and its thresholded self rather than assuming two equal populations, so it holds up where Otsu drifts into the background.
records.translation: Hentar sjónsviði þar sem hlutirnir eru lítill, bjartur minnihluti -- Li lágmarkar krossóreiðuna milli sjónsviðsins og þröskuldaðrar útgáfu þess í stað þess að gera ráð fyrir tveimur jöfnum hópum, svo það heldur þar sem Otsu rekur inn í bakgrunninn.

records.key: Suits a field with ONE dominant peak and a shoulder -- mostly background with faint objects on it. The level is geometric: the point on the histogram furthest from the line between the peak and the far end.
records.source: Suits a field with ONE dominant peak and a shoulder -- mostly background with faint objects on it. The level is geometric: the point on the histogram furthest from the line between the peak and the far end.
records.translation: Hentar sjónsviði með EINN ríkjandi topp og öxl -- að mestu bakgrunnur með daufum hlutum á. Stigið er rúmfræðilegt: punkturinn á stuðlaritinu sem er lengst frá línunni milli toppsins og fjarenda.

records.key: Suits a field with THREE or more populations -- background, a dim halo and bright objects -- where one level between all of them is a compromise that fits none. Set the class count and which class is the foreground.
records.source: Suits a field with THREE or more populations -- background, a dim halo and bright objects -- where one level between all of them is a compromise that fits none. Set the class count and which class is the foreground.
records.translation: Hentar sjónsviði með ÞRJÁ eða fleiri hópa -- bakgrunn, daufan geislabaug og bjarta hluti -- þar sem eitt stig milli þeirra allra er málamiðlun sem hentar engum. Stilltu fjölda flokka og hvaða flokkur er forgrunnurinn.

records.key: Suits a field with a long bright tail and little else; Yen maximises an entropy criterion and tends to cut higher than Otsu, keeping only the confident pixels.
records.source: Suits a field with a long bright tail and little else; Yen maximises an entropy criterion and tends to cut higher than Otsu, keeping only the confident pixels.
records.translation: Hentar sjónsviði með langan bjartan hala og lítið annað; Yen hámarkar óreiðuviðmið og sker yfirleitt hærra en Otsu og heldur aðeins öruggum pixlum.

records.key: Suits a field with two clear populations -- objects and background, with a valley between them in the histogram. It is the right first try and the wrong one for a field that is mostly background, where Li or Triangle cut better.
records.source: Suits a field with two clear populations -- objects and background, with a valley between them in the histogram. It is the right first try and the wrong one for a field that is mostly background, where Li or Triangle cut better.
records.translation: Hentar sjónsviði með tvo skýra hópa -- hluti og bakgrunn, með dal á milli í stuðlaritinu. Það er rétta fyrsta tilraunin en röng fyrir sjónsvið sem er að mestu bakgrunnur, þar sem Li eða Triangle skera betur.

records.key: Suits a histogram with two clear humps and a real valley between them; the level is the bottom of the valley. It refuses a histogram it cannot smooth into two humps, and says so rather than guessing.
records.source: Suits a histogram with two clear humps and a real valley between them; the level is the bottom of the valley. It refuses a histogram it cannot smooth into two humps, and says so rather than guessing.
records.translation: Hentar stuðlariti með tvo skýra hnúka og raunverulegan dal á milli; stigið er botn dalsins. Það hafnar stuðlariti sem það getur ekki mýkt í tvo hnúka og segir frá því frekar en að giska.

records.key: Suits cells and nuclei of the kind Cellpose was trained on, and is the only method here that knows what an object looks like rather than only how bright it is. It is slow without a GPU.
records.source: Suits cells and nuclei of the kind Cellpose was trained on, and is the only method here that knows what an object looks like rather than only how bright it is. It is slow without a GPU.
records.translation: Hentar frumum og kjörnum af því tagi sem Cellpose var þjálfað á, og er eina aðferðin hér sem veit hvernig hlutur lítur út frekar en aðeins hversu bjartur hann er. Hún er hæg án GPU.

records.key: Suits much what Otsu suits and is the classic Ridler-Calvard iteration: the level settles where it is the mean of the two means either side of it. A reasonable second opinion when Otsu looks wrong.
records.source: Suits much what Otsu suits and is the classic Ridler-Calvard iteration: the level settles where it is the mean of the two means either side of it. A reasonable second opinion when Otsu looks wrong.
records.translation: Hentar að mestu því sama og Otsu og er hin klassíska Ridler-Calvard-ítrun: stigið sest þar sem það er meðaltal meðaltalanna tveggja hvorum megin við það. Gott annað álit þegar Otsu virðist rangt.

records.key: Suits small round spots and puncta and hollow rings with a dark middle.
records.source: Suits small round spots and puncta and hollow rings with a dark middle.
records.translation: Hentar litlum kringlóttum blettum og punktum og holum hringjum með dökka miðju.

records.key: Suits small round spots and puncta, filaments, tubules and networks, solid blobby objects and hollow rings with a dark middle.
records.source: Suits small round spots and puncta, filaments, tubules and networks, solid blobby objects and hollow rings with a dark middle.
records.translation: Hentar litlum kringlóttum blettum og punktum, þráðum, pípum og netum, þéttum kekkjóttum hlutum og holum hringjum með dökka miðju.

records.key: Suits touching round objects with a bright centre -- nuclei, vacuoles, colonies. Each centre becomes one object, and two that touch come apart at the ridge between them rather than at a level.
records.source: Suits touching round objects with a bright centre -- nuclei, vacuoles, colonies. Each centre becomes one object, and two that touch come apart at the ridge between them rather than at a level.
records.translation: Hentar snertandi kringlóttum hlutum með bjarta miðju -- kjörnum, safabólum, sýklabyggðum. Hver miðja verður að einum hlut, og tveir sem snertast skiljast að við hrygginn á milli þeirra frekar en við tiltekið stig.

records.key: Supply dose and response columns, controls and units before curve fitting; this route does not require sequencing.
records.source: Supply dose and response columns, controls and units before curve fitting; this route does not require sequencing.
records.translation: Gefðu upp dálka skammta og svörunar, viðmið og einingar áður en ferill er mátaður; þessi leið krefst ekki raðgreiningar.

records.key: Supply frame interval and pixel calibration.
records.source: Supply frame interval and pixel calibration.
records.translation: Gefðu upp tímabil milli ramma og pixlakvörðun.

records.key: Supply the encoder feature table with matching object IDs; do not assume every GUI route automatically persists it.
records.source: Supply the encoder feature table with matching object IDs; do not assume every GUI route automatically persists it.
records.translation: Gefðu upp eiginleikatöflu kóðarans með samsvarandi auðkennum hluta; ekki gera ráð fyrir að allar GUI-leiðir vistu hana sjálfkrafa.

records.key: Supply the matching coordinate/feature columns when defining a selection.
records.source: Supply the matching coordinate/feature columns when defining a selection.

records.key: The Golgi apparatus is a series of flattened, cisternal membranes and similar vesicles usually arranged in close apposition to each other to form stacks. In mammalian cells, the Golgi apparatus is juxtanuclear, often pericentriolar. The stacks are connected laterally by tubules to create a perinuclear ribbon structure, the 'Golgi ribbon'. In plants and lower animal cells, the Golgi exists as many copies of discrete stacks dispersed throughout the cytoplasm. The Golgi is a polarized structure with, in most higher eukaryotic cells, a cis-face associated with a tubular reticular network of membranes facing the endoplasmic reticulum, the cis-Golgi network (CGN), a medial area of disk-shaped flattened cisternae, and a trans-face associated with another tubular reticular membrane network, the trans-Golgi network (TGN) directed toward the plasma membrane and compartments of the endocytic pathway. The Golgi apparatus receives the entire output of de novo synthesized polypeptides from the ER, and functions to posttranslationally process and sort them within vesicles destined to their proper final destination (e.g. plasma membrane, endosomes, lysosomes).

The Golgi apparatus receives the entire output of de novo synthesized polypeptides from the ER, and functions to posttranslationally process and sort them within vesicles destined to their proper final destination (e.g. plasma membrane, endosomes, lysosomes).
records.translation: Golgi-flókinn er röð flatra himnupoka og svipaðra blaðra sem yfirleitt liggja þétt hver að annarri og mynda stafla. Í spendýrafrumum liggur Golgi-flókinn við kjarnann, oft umhverfis deilikornin. Staflarnir eru tengdir til hliðanna með pípum og mynda borðalaga byggingu umhverfis kjarnann, 'Golgi ribbon'. Í plöntum og frumum lægri dýra er Golgi til sem mörg eintök aðskilinna stafla sem dreifast um umfrymið. Golgi er skautuð bygging sem í flestum frumum æðri heilkjörnunga hefur cis-hlið, tengda pípulaga netlaga himnukerfi sem snýr að frymisnetinu, cis-Golgi-netið (CGN), miðsvæði úr disklaga flötum himnupokum og trans-hlið, tengda öðru pípulaga netlaga himnukerfi, trans-Golgi-netinu (TGN), sem snýr að frumuhimnunni og hólfum innfrumunarleiðarinnar. Golgi-flókinn tekur við allri framleiðslu nýmyndaðra fjölpeptíða frá ER og vinnur þau eftir þýðingu og flokkar þau í blöðrur sem ætlaðar eru á réttan lokaáfangastað (t.d. frumuhimnu, innfrumubólur, leysikorn).

records.key: The complex and rigid layer surrounding the cell. Cell walls are found in bacteria, archaea, fungi, plants, and algae. The cell wall envelopes the inner or plasma membrane in all bacteria and is surrounded by the outer membrane in bacteria with 2 membranes (Gram-negative). Bacterial cell walls contain peptidoglycan while those of archaea are not made of peptidoglycan, but some archaea may contain pseudopeptidoglycan, which is composed of N-acetyltalosaminuronic acid, instead of N-acetyl muramic acid in peptidoglycan. The plant cell wall is made of fibrils of cellulose embedded in a matrix of several other kinds of polymers such as pectin and lignin. Algal cell walls are usually composed of cellulose, glycoproteins, sporopollenin, calcium and various polysaccharides such as manosyl, xylanes, alginic acid. Diatom cell walls (or frustules) contain silica. The cell wall plays a role in cell shape, cell stability and development, and protection against environmental dangers.

The size and coding capacity of the mitochondrial DNA varies considerably in different organisms, and encodes rRNAs, tRNAs and essential mitochondrial proteins.

records.key: The nucleolus is a non-membrane bound nuclear compartment found in eukaryotic cells which is the site of ribosome biogenesis. The interphase nucleolus is organized around the tandemly repeated genes for preribosomal RNA (rRNA). It is composed of at least 2 sub-compartments: the dense fibrillar component (DFC, also called pars fibrosa) and the granular component (GC or pars granulosa). The DFC contains newly synthesized preribosomal RNA and a collection of proteins; the GC is made up of nearly completed preribosomal particles destined for the cytoplasm. In most metazoans, but generally not in lower eukaryotes, a third component, the fibrillar center (FC), can be seen. Plant and animal nuclei can contain more than one nucleolus.

records.key: The vacuole is a generally large fluid-filled membrane-bound compartment in the cytoplasm. The precise form and function of vacuoles may vary between phyla. Plant vacuoles are among the best characterized. They differ in terms of their lumenal contents and processing enzymes, as well as on the basis of the type of integral proteins in their membranes (tonoplast intrinsic proteins, TIPs). Examples include the lytic vacuole, the storage vacuole and the lutoid. One important function of plant vacuoles is the maintenance of hydrostatic pressure. Other eukaryotes employ vacuoles for a variety of purposes, including storage (as in the yeast lysosome/vacuole), secretion and phagocytosis. In Protozoa, contractile vacuoles can be used to discharge water from the cytoplasm to the external environment.

Safabólur plantna eru meðal þeirra sem best er lýst. Þær eru ólíkar hvað varðar innihald holrýmis og vinnsluensím, sem og eftir gerð heilpróteina í himnum þeirra (tonoplast intrinsic proteins, TIPs). Aðrir heilkjörnungar nota safabólur í margvíslegum tilgangi, þar á meðal til geymslu (eins og í leysikorni/safabólu gers), seytingar og átfrumuáts. records.source: What fraction of full size the background is measured at. The surface is then scaled back up and subtracted from the full-size image, so only the ESTIMATE is smaller.
